## Summary
Uncompiled first-party files carry latent defects (mosaic_panel m_pendingTaskId, 4 orphan widgets, legacy vendored SicnuMainWindow/python console) - #224 class. This issue aggregates 3 related finding(s): SHELLB-7, SHELLB-8, VPATCH-7. Specifically, panels/mosaic_panel.cpp is referenced by no CMake target AND uses undeclared member m_pendingTaskId — cannot compile if ever revived. Specifically, Four widgets/ files are compiled by no target; roi_statistics_widget additionally computes its pixel window from raw map coordinates (garbage for any georeferenced raster) if revived. Specifically, Dead first-party files inside the vendored trees: src/gui/main_window.{h,cpp} (legacy SicnuMainWindow) and src/gui/python_console_widget.{h,cpp} (pre-#237 synchronous console) are not compiled by any target and carry real defects.

## Area
Build System / Packaging / Installation

## Type
build/portability

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/app/panels/mosaic_panel.cpp:149 (`if ( m_pendingTaskId >= 0 ) return;`); header src/app/panels/mosaic_panel.h:60-68 declares no such member` (MosaicPanel::runMosaic)
- `src/app/widgets/roi_statistics_widget.cpp:127-137 (xOff/yOff from bbox map coordinates); dead siblings: src/app/widgets/multi_temporal_widget.cpp, src/app/widgets/cross_section_widget.cpp, src/app/widgets/annotation_widget.cpp` (RoiStatisticsWidget::computeStatistics)
- `src/gui/main_window.cpp:1-647; python_console_widget.cpp:58-80` (SicnuMainWindow / PythonConsoleWidget)

## User impact
- Same class as closed #224 (files never compiled); latent compile break for whoever resurrects the panel
- Rot risk and #224-class coverage gap; latent incorrect statistics
- Hygiene/rot risk; a future 're-enable' would regress #237 and ship the double-add layer bug. No runtime exposure at HEAD.

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (SHELLB-7)**: n/a (any attempt to build or reuse the panel)
- **Trigger (SHELLB-8)**: n/a today; becomes user-facing garbage stats if the file is ever added to a target
- **Trigger (VPATCH-7)**: None at HEAD; any future re-wiring of these files into a target.

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (SHELLB-7)**: Dead files either compiled or at least compilable
- **Expected (SHELLB-8)**: Dead widgets removed or maintained; ROI stats use geotransform-inverse mapping (compare cross_section_widget.cpp:53-56 which does it correctly)
- **Expected (VPATCH-7)**: Legacy files either deleted or kept in sync with the fixes that landed elsewhere.

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (SHELLB-7)**: Silently excluded from the build and broken if included
- **Actual (SHELLB-8)**: Four orphaned files, one with a coordinate-space bug and one no-op stub
- **Actual (VPATCH-7)**: Unrotted-in-place copies that silently diverge from the fixed live implementations.

## Root cause
- **SHELLB-7**: confirmed (latent-only, uncompiled)
  - *Callchain*: `n/a (file not compiled)`
  - *Code context*: ``grep -rn mosaic_panel src --include=CMakeLists.txt` finds no reference — the file is dead (MosaicDialog is the live path per the in-file comment). Line 149 reads member `m_pendingTaskId` which is not declared in mosaic_panel.h (members end at line 68 with `sicnu::app::GuiJobHandle m_jobHandle{this};`), so adding the file back to any target would be a compile error. The intended busy-guard is presumably the run-button disablement plus GuiJobHandle::isRunning().`
- **SHELLB-8**: confirmed (latent-only, uncompiled)
  - *Callchain*: `n/a (not compiled); latent: computeStatistics -> GDALRasterIO with xOff=bbox.xMinimum()`
  - *Code context*: `src/app/CMakeLists.txt lists only histogram_widget, histogram_stretch_widget, band_composition_rail, rs_toolbar_flow_host, spectral_profile_widget, band_role_combo, raster_layer_combo, resolution_widget, crs_selector, progress_dialog, comparison_widget, guided_workflow_widget (+python_script_editor under a flag) — roi_statistics/multi_temporal/cross_section/annotation are absent from every CMakeLists. Inside roi_statistics_widget.cpp the read window is computed as `int xOff = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(bbox.xMinimum())); int yOff = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(bbox.yMinimum())); int xSize = std::min(m_rasterLayer->width() - xOff, static_cast<int>(bbox.width()) + 1); ...` treating layer-CRS map coordinates (e.g. UTM ~500000) as pixel offsets: for any georeferenced raster xSize/ySize go negative, every band is skipped by `continue`, and updateTable() then renders the zero-initialized BandStats (all 0.0 / 0 pixels) while the summary claims success. annotation_widget.cpp is a log-only stub (onAddText just SICNU_LOG_INFO; Clear All clears nothing).`
- **VPATCH-7**: confirmed (latent-only, uncompiled)
  - *Callchain*: `N/A (dead code; zero instantiation sites — only a forward declaration in src/plugins/layer_tree/layer_tree_plugin.h:7).`
  - *Code context*: `No CMakeLists references either file (grep over all CMake/txt) and no source includes their headers; the real shell is src/app/main_window.cpp and the real console src/python/sicnu_python_console.cpp (src/app/CMakeLists.txt:305). If ever recompiled they reintroduce defects: SicnuMainWindow::loadRasterLayer adds every layer twice ('QgsProject::instance()->addMapLayer(layer)' with addToLegend=true followed by 'group->addLayer(layer)'); m_layerTree (QgsLayerTreeView) is never created so selectedLayers() always returns empty and Layer-menu actions are no-ops; PythonConsoleWidget::executeCommand runs arbitrary Python synchronously on the GUI thread via QgisPython::runString — exactly the defect class #237 fixed in the live console.`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: All members verified as written but are latent by construction (files compiled by no target — the #224 class). SHELLB-7: mosaic_panel.cpp:149 reads m_pendingTaskId which the header does not declare (grep: no match in mosaic_panel.h); no CMake target references the file (grep over CMakeLists returned only the sources) — cannot compile if revived. VPATCH-7: src/gui/main_window.* and python_console_widget.* are unreferenced by any target (live shell is src/app/main_window.cpp, live console src/python/sicnu_python_console.cpp). Because none of these can execute in the current build, none has runtime reachability; per the drop rule they are all marked latent.
- **Review note**: Drop or explicitly label all three as latent dead-file defects (no runtime impact possible at HEAD); the batch is best reframed as 'revival debt' rather than live P3 defects.
- **Finding SHELLB-7**: ``grep -rn mosaic_panel src --include=CMakeLists.txt` finds no reference — the file is dead (MosaicDialog is the live path per the in-file comment). Line 149 reads member `m_pendingTaskId` which is not declared in mosaic_panel.h (members end at line 68 with `sicnu::app::GuiJobHandle m_jobHandle{this};`), so adding the file back to any target would be a compile error. The intended busy-guard is presumably the run-button disablement plus GuiJobHandle::isRunning().`
- **Finding SHELLB-8**: `src/app/CMakeLists.txt lists only histogram_widget, histogram_stretch_widget, band_composition_rail, rs_toolbar_flow_host, spectral_profile_widget, band_role_combo, raster_layer_combo, resolution_widget, crs_selector, progress_dialog, comparison_widget, guided_workflow_widget (+python_script_editor under a flag) — roi_statistics/multi_temporal/cross_section/annotation are absent from every CMakeLists. Inside roi_statistics_widget.cpp the read window is computed as `int xOff = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(bbox.xMinimum())); int yOff = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(bbox.yMinimum())); int xSize = std::min(m_rasterLayer->width() - xOff, static_cast<int>(bbox.width()) + 1); ...` treating layer-CRS map coordinates (e.g. UTM ~500000) as pixel offsets: for any georeferenced raster xSize/ySize go negative, every band is skipped by `continue`, and updateTable() then renders the zero-initialized BandStats (all 0.0 / 0 pixels) while the summary claims success. annotation_widget.cpp is a log-only stub (onAddText just SICNU_LOG_INFO; Clear All clears nothing).`
- **Finding VPATCH-7**: `No CMakeLists references either file (grep over all CMake/txt) and no source includes their headers; the real shell is src/app/main_window.cpp and the real console src/python/sicnu_python_console.cpp (src/app/CMakeLists.txt:305). If ever recompiled they reintroduce defects: SicnuMainWindow::loadRasterLayer adds every layer twice ('QgsProject::instance()->addMapLayer(layer)' with addToLegend=true followed by 'group->addLayer(layer)'); m_layerTree (QgsLayerTreeView) is never created so selectedLayers() always returns empty and Layer-menu actions are no-ops; PythonConsoleWidget::executeCommand runs arbitrary Python synchronously on the GUI thread via QgisPython::runString — exactly the defect class #237 fixed in the live console.`

## Suggested fix
- Update CMakeLists.txt install rules, dependency discovery, and RPATH configuration to ensure correct runtime linking and packaging.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (SHELLB-7, SHELLB-8, VPATCH-7).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- VPATCH-7 references #237 (console) and the whole batch is the #224 class; no dup of an open issue.
- Finding SHELLB-7: #224 covered five TEST files; this is a src/app panel, not listed there.
- Finding SHELLB-8: #224 covered never-compiled TEST files only.
- Finding VPATCH-7: #237 fixed the live sicnu_python_console; nothing tracks these dead copies. #236 layer-menu UAF is a different file.
title: [P3][build/portability] Uncompiled first-party files carry latent defects (mosaic_panel m_pendingTaskId, 4 orphan widgets, legacy vendored SicnuMainWindow/python console) - #224 class

body:
## Summary
gdal test suites exercise zero first-party code while real wrapper defects ship (coverage illusion). Specifically, Platform-behavior tests masquerade as product coverage in the gdal tool/error suites — zero first-party code exercised while real wrapper defects were shipping.

## Area
Test Suite / Test Contracts & Invariants

## Type
tests/contract

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `tests/test_gdal_tool_wrapper.cpp:9-86 (also tests/test_gdal_null_band.cpp:19-104, tests/test_gdal_safe_call.cpp:49-70, tests/test_gdal_wrapper.cpp:245-256)` (TEST_CASE("QProcess MergedChannels captures stderr") et al.)

## User impact
- False coverage signal on the CLI wrapper error-handling seam; combined with TESTS-1's tautological bandNoDataValue test, the GDAL error/nodata contract has effectively no behavioral pinning.

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (TESTS-4)**: Any change to first-party gdal tool wrapper / error capture code: these suites cannot fail.

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (TESTS-4)**: Tests execute the first-party wrapper (e.g. gdal_tools executor with a failing CLI) and assert captured stderr/error JSON.

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (TESTS-4)**: 4 passing test cases that assert Qt/QProcess and GDAL library behavior only.

## Root cause
- **TESTS-4**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `ctest reports 'Gdal tool wrapper error handling' tests as passing -> reviewers skip deepening coverage -> first-party wrapper error paths regress undetected`
  - *Code context*: `test_gdal_tool_wrapper.cpp is titled 'Test GDAL tool wrapper error handling' and its 4 cases spin QProcess('bash') to assert Qt's MergedChannels/SeparateChannels semantics — the file never includes, links, or calls any first-party wrapper (no gdal_tools symbols; CMake target links only Qt6::Core + Catch2). test_gdal_null_band.cpp's 4 cases call raw GDALCreate/GDALGetRasterBand/GDALRasterIO and assert GDAL's own null-band behavior; line 81 admits it: 'This test demonstrates the pattern the dialog code should use'. test_gdal_safe_call.cpp:49-70 'Safe open with error handling' hand-writes a try/catch around GDALOpen instead of exercising GDAL_SAFE_CALL on a first-party path. test_gdal_wrapper.cpp:245-256 covers bandNoDataValue with (void)nodata; (void)hasNodata; REQUIRE(true). These create an appearance of coverage over exactly the seams where real defects later surfaced from other audits: gdal CLI wrappers dropped FileDestination outputs and emitted wrong CLI arguments (#196/#169) and swallow failures (#228). The tests are all green while testing none of that code.`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: Verified: test_gdal_tool_wrapper.cpp:9-86 fires QProcess('bash') and asserts Qt's MergedChannels/SeparateChannels semantics — the title says 'GDAL tool wrapper error handling' but no first-party symbol appears (no include, no link of wrappers). Sibling files (test_gdal_null_band.cpp, test_gdal_safe_call.cpp:49-70, test_gdal_wrapper.cpp:245-256) share the pattern per evidence. This is a naming/coverage illusion finding rather than a product bug — valid as a P3 test-hygiene item.
- **Review note**: Classify as test-hygiene (coverage metric abusoire), not a product defect; severity P3 stands.
- **Finding TESTS-4**: `test_gdal_tool_wrapper.cpp is titled 'Test GDAL tool wrapper error handling' and its 4 cases spin QProcess('bash') to assert Qt's MergedChannels/SeparateChannels semantics — the file never includes, links, or calls any first-party wrapper (no gdal_tools symbols; CMake target links only Qt6::Core + Catch2). test_gdal_null_band.cpp's 4 cases call raw GDALCreate/GDALGetRasterBand/GDALRasterIO and assert GDAL's own null-band behavior; line 81 admits it: 'This test demonstrates the pattern the dialog code should use'. test_gdal_safe_call.cpp:49-70 'Safe open with error handling' hand-writes a try/catch around GDALOpen instead of exercising GDAL_SAFE_CALL on a first-party path. test_gdal_wrapper.cpp:245-256 covers bandNoDataValue with (void)nodata; (void)hasNodata; REQUIRE(true). These create an appearance of coverage over exactly the seams where real defects later surfaced from other audits: gdal CLI wrappers dropped FileDestination outputs and emitted wrong CLI arguments (#196/#169) and swallow failures (#228). The tests are all green while testing none of that code.`

## Suggested fix
- Address the root cause directly with minimal, surgical changes adhering to project coding standards.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (TESTS-4).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- Distinct from #226/#226-family tautology fixes; no prior coverage-illusion issue for the gdal suites.
- Finding TESTS-4: #224 listed five uncompiled test files (different set — OTB operators, operation logger, python script editor, python bindings, histogram-equalize; all now compiled, verified). These platform-masquerade files were compiled and green the whole time — not covered by #224/#225/#226/#229/#241.
title: [P3][tests/contract] gdal test suites exercise zero first-party code while real wrapper defects ship (coverage illusion)

body:
## Summary
Build/runtime minors batch: installed data/styles unresolved; dev-run plugins path; orphan sample-data tool+mislabel; AppImage missing Qt plugin/GDAL data; dead build seams; WITH_VECTORTILE=OFF breaks; dead HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN; unloadAll signal-after-unload. This issue aggregates 8 related finding(s): BUILD-8, BUILD-9, BUILD-10, BUILD-11, BUILD-12, VPATCH-5, VPATCH-6, VPATCH-8. Specifically, Installed app resolves styles.qss/fonts and all data/ payloads only via the source-tree walk-up; data/ has no install rule at all. Specifically, Build-tree app probes <exe>/../plugins but plugin targets build into <build>/src/plugins/* — dev-run loads zero C++ plugins. Specifically, generate_sample_data.cpp is wired to nothing, and its training ROIs mislabel 3 of 5 classes even if built manually.

## Area
Build System / Packaging / Installation

## Type
build/portability

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/app/CMakeLists.txt:344-378` (install(resources) / AppPaths::resolveDataPath)
- `src/app/main_window.cpp:154` (PluginHost::loadPlugins)
- `tools/generate_sample_data.cpp:294-330` (ROIDef rois[])
- `packaging/build-appimage.sh:70-86` (linuxdeploy invocation)
- `cmake/DownloadGdalTools.cmake:1-33` ((module includes))
- `src/core/CMakeLists.txt:1026-1045 vs 2300-2309` (QGIS_CORE_SRCS / WITH_VECTORTILE)
- `src/core/CMakeLists.txt:2792-2798` (HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN / qgis_core target_link_libraries(Qt6Keychain::Qt6Keychain))
- `src/core/plugin_host.cpp:68-113, 157-174` (PluginHost::unloadAll / PluginHost::loadPlugin)

## User impact
- Functional degradation of every installed deployment; invisible to CI because the install smoke test only runs `sicnu_geo_rs_cli --help`.
- The 'Plugin architecture' feature is dead in the primary developer workflow (only works from an installed tree where bin/../plugins exists).
- The guided-lab workflows advertised by guided_workflow_widget.cpp:803 ('Pipeline JSON labs: data/pipelines/obia_*.json') cannot run as shipped, and would train mislabeled classifiers if the data were generated.
- The shipped packaging script cannot produce a working self-contained AppImage on a clean machine.
- Misleading build surface; the OTB bundle/lib staging expectations in the scripts have no producing targets, so those code paths operate on empty globs.
- Build-config portability only; no runtime effect with the default ON.
- Build-config dead code; no runtime effect where Qt6Keychain exists.
- Latent UAF/double-init in the plugin facade used by the app shell and CLI; low present-day reachability.

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (BUILD-8)**: Running the installed (non-source-tree) application built by the documented install flow
- **Trigger (BUILD-9)**: Every run from the build tree (the README 'Build' flow `./sicnu_geo_rs`)
- **Trigger (BUILD-10)**: Anyone trying to materialize the sample data referenced by the shipped teaching pipelines
- **Trigger (BUILD-11)**: Running packaging/build-appimage.sh
- **Trigger (BUILD-12)**: Anyone relying on these modules' documented behavior (installed GDAL CLI tools, staged OTB bundle target, svm/muparserx libs in the build tree)
- **Trigger (VPATCH-5)**: Configure/build with WITH_VECTORTILE=OFF.
- **Trigger (VPATCH-6)**: Configure without Qt6Keychain present.
- **Trigger (VPATCH-8)**: Requires a consumer of pluginUnloaded/plugin() during teardown (none exists at HEAD — only pluginLoaded/pluginError lambdas in src/gui/main_window.cpp dead code and app-side logging), or loading two plugins reporting the same name().

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (BUILD-8)**: Install rules for data/ plus install-layout candidates in resolveRuntimeDataPath (mirroring the fixed worker_daemon.py seam)
- **Expected (BUILD-9)**: LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins on the plugin targets (matching the ../plugins probe and the install DESTINATION 'plugins')
- **Expected (BUILD-10)**: A build target/script that generates data/samples, with ROI boxes overlapping their intended land-cover regions
- **Expected (BUILD-11)**: --plugin qt (or explicit Qt plugin deployment), bundled proj.db/GDAL data plus AppRun exports, and a complete lib set
- **Expected (BUILD-12)**: Either wired in or removed
- **Expected (VPATCH-5)**: Source list also guarded (or the option removed).
- **Expected (VPATCH-6)**: If keychain is meant to be optional, its uses in qgsauthmanager need #ifdef HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN guards.
- **Expected (VPATCH-8)**: Mark entries unloaded (or erase) before emitting; reject/handle duplicate plugin names explicitly (pluginError signal exists for this).

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (BUILD-8)**: Installed app silently loses theming/fonts and the shipped custom-tool catalog and sample pipelines
- **Actual (BUILD-9)**: Both shipped C++ plugins and the sample Python plugin are silently absent in dev runs
- **Actual (BUILD-10)**: No generator is reachable from the build; the only candidate tool produces mislabeled training data
- **Actual (BUILD-11)**: AppImage lacks Qt plugins, QML, and PROJ/GDAL data, and inherits the missing libsicnu_agent
- **Actual (BUILD-12)**: Silent no-ops that make the build system advertise capabilities it does not deliver
- **Actual (VPATCH-5)**: Option exists but OFF path fails to build — dead/broken configuration knob.
- **Actual (VPATCH-6)**: Define is emitted but never read; the build still hard-requires Qt6Keychain. Misleading no-op guard.
- **Actual (VPATCH-8)**: Dangling-instance window during emit; silent shadowing on duplicate names.

## Root cause
- **BUILD-8**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `cmake --install → <prefix>/bin/sicnu_geo_rs → resolveDataPath("resources/styles.qss") walks up from bin/, finds no CMakeLists.txt/data → '/resources/styles.qss' → QFile::open fails → default Qt look, no fonts, empty generic-CLI tool set`
  - *Code context*: `src/app/CMakeLists.txt:345-354 installs resources/fonts, resources/icons and styles.qss(+dark) to share/sicnu_geo_rs/resources, and src/python/isolated/CMakeLists.txt:39-42 installs worker scripts — but there is no install rule for the data/ subtree (data/tools/custom, data/pipelines, data/processing/toolbox_manifest.json, data/plugins/sample_plugin). Runtime resolution for all of these goes through AppPaths::resolveDataPath (src/app/app_paths.h:35-38) → resolveRuntimeDataPath walk-up, which has no install-prefix candidate — unlike AppPaths::qgisRefResourcesDir()/samplesDataDir() (app_paths.h:52-93) which do probe ../share/sicnu_geo_rs/... layouts. main.cpp:235-242 loads fonts/styles.qss through this path and logs 'Could not load theme' when missing; the runtime generic-CLI provider loads shipped tools via resolveRuntimeDataPath("data/tools/custom") (src/processing/providers/generic_cli/provider.cpp:40, src/processing/tools/cli_tool_discovery.cpp:144).`
- **BUILD-9**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `dev run ./sicnu_geo_rs from build dir → QDir(<build>/plugins).exists() false → qWarning → layer-tree and processing C++ plugins never loaded, no Python plugins discovered`
  - *Code context*: `main_window.cpp:154 `m_pluginHost->loadPlugins(QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath() + "/../plugins")`. The exe is at <build>/sicnu_geo_rs, so it probes <build>/plugins. The plugin targets (src/plugins/layer_tree/CMakeLists.txt:1, src/plugins/processing/CMakeLists.txt:1) set no LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY, so Ninja places them at <build>/src/plugins/layer_tree/liblayer_tree_plugin.so and <build>/src/plugins/processing/libprocessing_plugin.so (verified in the audit build). PluginHost::loadPlugins (src/core/plugin_host.cpp:41-48) just qWarning's 'Plugin directory not found' and returns; data/plugins/sample_plugin is likewise never staged into <build>/plugins.`
- **BUILD-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `user compiles the tool by hand → training_samples.shp with Water=vegetation, BareSoil=Urban, Forest=Urban pixels → rs:supervised_classification / rs:obia_classify labs train on wrong labels`
  - *Code context*: `No CMakeLists, script, or doc references tools/generate_sample_data.cpp (repo-wide grep), and data/samples/ does not exist — yet 8 of the 10 shipped data/pipelines JSONs reference data/samples/landsat_sample.tif and data/samples/training_samples.shp. If compiled manually, the ROI geometry is wrong: geotransform is (116.0,40.0) with 0.001 px over 256 px, so e.g. the 'Water' ROI at lat 39.87-39.90 maps to rows 100-130 (ny 0.39-0.51) while getLandCoverClass puts Water at ny>0.85 → it samples vegetation; 'Bare Soil' ROI (nx 0.195-0.273, ny 0.117-0.273) hits the Urban rule (nx<0.4 && ny<0.3); 'Forest' ROI (nx 0.273-0.344, ny 0.078-0.234) also hits Urban (forest requires ny>0.3).`
- **BUILD-11**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `build-appimage.sh → make install (missing sicnu_agent) → linuxdeploy (no qt plugin, no geodata) → AppImage that cannot start (loader error) and, once that is fixed, cannot create a platform plugin or transform CRS without host files`
  - *Code context*: `Lines 79-83 invoke linuxdeploy with only --appdir/--desktop-file/--icon-file/--output appimage — no `--plugin qt`. linuxdeploy's default dependency resolution walks DT_NEEDED only; Qt platform plugins (libqxcb/libqoffscreen), imageformats, and QML module files are dlopen'ed and never referenced, so none are bundled (the app links Qt6QuickWidgets/Qml per readelf). Nothing bundles or env-sets PROJ data (proj.db) or GDAL_DATA either — the only data copied is resources/fonts|icons|styles.qss and symbology-style.xml (lines 24-38); there is no AppRun hook (linuxdeploy's generated AppRun sets no GDAL_DATA/PROJ_LIB/QT_PLUGIN_PATH). The script also inherits BUILD-1 via `make install DESTDIR="$APPDIR"` (line 21): libsicnu_agent.so is not in the AppDir, so linuxdeploy's ldd resolution of usr/bin/sicnu_geo_rs fails.`
- **BUILD-12**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `n/a (never executed)`
  - *Code context*: `Repo-wide grep for include()/add_subdirectory() consumers: cmake/DownloadGdalTools.cmake and cmake/DownloadOtbTools.cmake (which promise installed tools/gdal + tools/otb) are included by no CMakeLists; images/CMakeLists.txt and its icons/svg/themes subdirs are never add_subdirectory'd from the root (and reference undefined WITH_DESKTOP/QGIS_DATA_DIR); cmake/sicnu_otb_bundle.cmake's sicnu_setup_otb_bundle() has no caller (the bundling is done ad hoc by scripts/build_with_otb.sh:36-40); cmake/LibSVM/CMakeLists.txt and cmake/MuParserX/CMakeLists.txt define targets nothing adds (yet bundle_otb_tools.sh:17-24 expects libmuparserx.so*/libsvm.so* in <build>/lib, which nothing produces); cmake/VcpkgToolchain.cmake and cmake/VcpkgInstallDeps.cmake are unreferenced (Windows CI uses the preinstalled vcpkg toolchain directly).`
- **VPATCH-5**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `cmake -DWITH_VECTORTILE=OFF -> protobuf_generate_cpp skipped -> vectortile sources still compiled -> fatal error: vector_tile.pb.h: No such file.`
  - *Code context*: `Root CMakeLists.txt:175 'option(WITH_VECTORTILE "" ON)'. Local delta wraps only 'protobuf_generate_cpp(...)' + 'add_definitions(-DWITH_VECTORTILE)' in if(WITH_VECTORTILE), but the ~20 'vectortile/*.cpp' entries remain unconditional in QGIS_CORE_SRCS and vectortile/qgsvectortilemvtencoder.h:23 and qgsvectortilemvtdecoder.h:24 '#include "vector_tile.pb.h"' unconditionally — with the option OFF the generated header does not exist, so compilation fails. The code-level guards (#ifdef WITH_VECTORTILE in qgsproviderregistry.cpp:39/207, qgspallabeling.cpp:52/4441) show the OFF configuration was intended to be supported.`
- **VPATCH-6**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Build on a system without Qt6Keychain -> link target skipped and define added -> qgsauthmanager.o references QKeychain:: symbols with no library -> link failure.`
  - *Code context*: `Local delta: 'if(TARGET Qt6Keychain::Qt6Keychain) target_link_libraries(qgis_core Qt6Keychain::Qt6Keychain) target_compile_definitions(qgis_core PRIVATE "HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN") endif()'. Repo-wide grep finds ZERO #ifdef HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN consumers; src/core/auth/qgsauthmanager.h:42 '#include <qt6keychain/keychain.h>' and qgsauthmanager.cpp:3631-3913 use QKeychain:: symbols unconditionally.`
- **VPATCH-8**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `PluginHost::~PluginHost -> unloadAll -> emit pluginUnloaded -> (future consumer) -> PluginHost::plugin(name) -> dangling SicnuPluginInterface*.`
  - *Code context*: `unloadAll(): 'it.value().instance->unload(); if (it.value().loader) it.value().loader->unload(); emit pluginUnloaded(it.key());' — loader->unload() destroys the plugin's root object, but the entry stays in m_plugins with loaded==true and a dangling instance until the loop finishes; any slot connected to pluginUnloaded that calls pluginHost()->plugin(name) receives the freed pointer for a virtual call. loadPlugin() has no isPluginLoaded check: 'm_plugins[interface->name()] = info;' silently orphans a previously loaded same-name plugin's loader and instance (double initialize, orphaned QPluginLoader child).`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: Highest-risk member verified. BUILD-8: src/app/CMakeLists.txt:344-378 installs fonts/icons/styles.qss but has NO install rule for data/ (the same payload the resolveRuntimeDataPath walk-up serves), and resolveRuntimeDataPath is the ONLY installed-app data probe — same exe-dir walk-up family as BUILD-6. Other members accepted from evidence (dev-run plugins path, orphan sample-data tool, AppImage gdal-data/Qt plugin gaps, dead seams, WITH_VECTORTILE=OFF, dead HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN, unloadAll signal-after-unload).
- **Review note**: None. All P3.
- **Finding BUILD-8**: `src/app/CMakeLists.txt:345-354 installs resources/fonts, resources/icons and styles.qss(+dark) to share/sicnu_geo_rs/resources, and src/python/isolated/CMakeLists.txt:39-42 installs worker scripts — but there is no install rule for the data/ subtree (data/tools/custom, data/pipelines, data/processing/toolbox_manifest.json, data/plugins/sample_plugin). Runtime resolution for all of these goes through AppPaths::resolveDataPath (src/app/app_paths.h:35-38) → resolveRuntimeDataPath walk-up, which has no install-prefix candidate — unlike AppPaths::qgisRefResourcesDir()/samplesDataDir() (app_paths.h:52-93) which do probe ../share/sicnu_geo_rs/... layouts. main.cpp:235-242 loads fonts/styles.qss through this path and logs 'Could not load theme' when missing; the runtime generic-CLI provider loads shipped tools via resolveRuntimeDataPath("data/tools/custom") (src/processing/providers/generic_cli/provider.cpp:40, src/processing/tools/cli_tool_discovery.cpp:144).`
- **Finding BUILD-9**: `main_window.cpp:154 `m_pluginHost->loadPlugins(QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath() + "/../plugins")`. The exe is at <build>/sicnu_geo_rs, so it probes <build>/plugins. The plugin targets (src/plugins/layer_tree/CMakeLists.txt:1, src/plugins/processing/CMakeLists.txt:1) set no LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY, so Ninja places them at <build>/src/plugins/layer_tree/liblayer_tree_plugin.so and <build>/src/plugins/processing/libprocessing_plugin.so (verified in the audit build). PluginHost::loadPlugins (src/core/plugin_host.cpp:41-48) just qWarning's 'Plugin directory not found' and returns; data/plugins/sample_plugin is likewise never staged into <build>/plugins.`
- **Finding BUILD-10**: `No CMakeLists, script, or doc references tools/generate_sample_data.cpp (repo-wide grep), and data/samples/ does not exist — yet 8 of the 10 shipped data/pipelines JSONs reference data/samples/landsat_sample.tif and data/samples/training_samples.shp. If compiled manually, the ROI geometry is wrong: geotransform is (116.0,40.0) with 0.001 px over 256 px, so e.g. the 'Water' ROI at lat 39.87-39.90 maps to rows 100-130 (ny 0.39-0.51) while getLandCoverClass puts Water at ny>0.85 → it samples vegetation; 'Bare Soil' ROI (nx 0.195-0.273, ny 0.117-0.273) hits the Urban rule (nx<0.4 && ny<0.3); 'Forest' ROI (nx 0.273-0.344, ny 0.078-0.234) also hits Urban (forest requires ny>0.3).`
- **Finding BUILD-11**: `Lines 79-83 invoke linuxdeploy with only --appdir/--desktop-file/--icon-file/--output appimage — no `--plugin qt`. linuxdeploy's default dependency resolution walks DT_NEEDED only; Qt platform plugins (libqxcb/libqoffscreen), imageformats, and QML module files are dlopen'ed and never referenced, so none are bundled (the app links Qt6QuickWidgets/Qml per readelf). Nothing bundles or env-sets PROJ data (proj.db) or GDAL_DATA either — the only data copied is resources/fonts|icons|styles.qss and symbology-style.xml (lines 24-38); there is no AppRun hook (linuxdeploy's generated AppRun sets no GDAL_DATA/PROJ_LIB/QT_PLUGIN_PATH). The script also inherits BUILD-1 via `make install DESTDIR="$APPDIR"` (line 21): libsicnu_agent.so is not in the AppDir, so linuxdeploy's ldd resolution of usr/bin/sicnu_geo_rs fails.`
- **Finding BUILD-12**: `Repo-wide grep for include()/add_subdirectory() consumers: cmake/DownloadGdalTools.cmake and cmake/DownloadOtbTools.cmake (which promise installed tools/gdal + tools/otb) are included by no CMakeLists; images/CMakeLists.txt and its icons/svg/themes subdirs are never add_subdirectory'd from the root (and reference undefined WITH_DESKTOP/QGIS_DATA_DIR); cmake/sicnu_otb_bundle.cmake's sicnu_setup_otb_bundle() has no caller (the bundling is done ad hoc by scripts/build_with_otb.sh:36-40); cmake/LibSVM/CMakeLists.txt and cmake/MuParserX/CMakeLists.txt define targets nothing adds (yet bundle_otb_tools.sh:17-24 expects libmuparserx.so*/libsvm.so* in <build>/lib, which nothing produces); cmake/VcpkgToolchain.cmake and cmake/VcpkgInstallDeps.cmake are unreferenced (Windows CI uses the preinstalled vcpkg toolchain directly).`
- **Finding VPATCH-5**: `Root CMakeLists.txt:175 'option(WITH_VECTORTILE "" ON)'. Local delta wraps only 'protobuf_generate_cpp(...)' + 'add_definitions(-DWITH_VECTORTILE)' in if(WITH_VECTORTILE), but the ~20 'vectortile/*.cpp' entries remain unconditional in QGIS_CORE_SRCS and vectortile/qgsvectortilemvtencoder.h:23 and qgsvectortilemvtdecoder.h:24 '#include "vector_tile.pb.h"' unconditionally — with the option OFF the generated header does not exist, so compilation fails. The code-level guards (#ifdef WITH_VECTORTILE in qgsproviderregistry.cpp:39/207, qgspallabeling.cpp:52/4441) show the OFF configuration was intended to be supported.`
- **Finding VPATCH-6**: `Local delta: 'if(TARGET Qt6Keychain::Qt6Keychain) target_link_libraries(qgis_core Qt6Keychain::Qt6Keychain) target_compile_definitions(qgis_core PRIVATE "HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN") endif()'. Repo-wide grep finds ZERO #ifdef HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN consumers; src/core/auth/qgsauthmanager.h:42 '#include <qt6keychain/keychain.h>' and qgsauthmanager.cpp:3631-3913 use QKeychain:: symbols unconditionally.`
- **Finding VPATCH-8**: `unloadAll(): 'it.value().instance->unload(); if (it.value().loader) it.value().loader->unload(); emit pluginUnloaded(it.key());' — loader->unload() destroys the plugin's root object, but the entry stays in m_plugins with loaded==true and a dangling instance until the loop finishes; any slot connected to pluginUnloaded that calls pluginHost()->plugin(name) receives the freed pointer for a virtual call. loadPlugin() has no isPluginLoaded check: 'm_plugins[interface->name()] = info;' silently orphans a previously loaded same-name plugin's loader and instance (double initialize, orphaned QPluginLoader child).`

## Suggested fix
- Update CMakeLists.txt install rules, dependency discovery, and RPATH configuration to ensure correct runtime linking and packaging.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (BUILD-8, BUILD-9, BUILD-10, BUILD-11, BUILD-12, VPATCH-5, VPATCH-6, VPATCH-8).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- BUILD-8 shares the #232 walk-up family (install side of worker_daemon only); not a duplicate.
- Finding BUILD-8: #232 covered worker_daemon.py only (verified fixed at HEAD: install rule + matching probe path); #180 covered sicnu_core. This covers resources/data/ payloads.
- Finding BUILD-9: No closed issue covers the build-tree plugin output directory.
- Finding BUILD-10: No closed issue covers sample-data generation.
- Finding BUILD-11: No closed issue covers AppImage packaging.
- Finding BUILD-12: #234's batch did not cover these modules.
- Finding VPATCH-5: #234 build/portability batch does not mention WITH_VECTORTILE.
- Finding VPATCH-6: #234 'install_deps.sh missing GSL' etc. does not cover the keychain define.
- Finding VPATCH-8: #233 covers Python adapter/AppInterfaceBridge lifetime, not PluginHost C++ unload ordering; #234 mentions a PluginHost name-collision LEAK in build context — this is the runtime duplicate-name behavior plus emit-order UAF window, distinct and latent.
title: [P3][build/portability] Build/runtime minors batch: installed data/styles unresolved; dev-run plugins path; orphan sample-data tool+mislabel; AppImage missing Qt plugin/GDAL data; dead build seams; WITH_VECTORTILE=OFF breaks; dead HAVE_QT6KEYCHAIN; unloadAll signal-after-unload

body:
## Summary
Shell/UI minors batch 3: Add-Layer menu registers empty path; swipe Space hijack; sample-data success count wrong; group-click clears current layer; offset-curve setting key mixup; hasM-from-hasZ; SchemaFormBuilder enum defaults; statistics null-deref; stubbed-editor degradations. This issue aggregates 12 related finding(s): SHELLA-2, SHELLA-6, SHELLA-7, SHELLA-8, SHELLB-2, SHELLB-9, SHELLB-10, VPATCH-4, UIF-11, DLGA-10, DLGB-10, SHELLB-6. Specifically, Layer-tree context menu 'Add Raster/Vector Layer...' never opens a file dialog — it registers an empty path as a Missing asset and pops an 'asset not ready' error. Specifically, Swipe tool's Space-to-toggle-direction is hijacked by the global Space=Pan action shortcut — pressing Space silently replaces the swipe tool with pan; setMouseFollow(false) is also a no-op. Specifically, loadSampleData counts every file as loaded regardless of failures and reports 'Loaded N sample datasets' even when nothing loaded.

## Area
GUI / Application Shell / Dialogs

## Type
ui/interaction

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/app/layer_tree_menu.cpp:27-35, 92-100` (LayerTreeMenuProvider::createContextMenu)
- `src/app/map_tools/swipe_map_tool.cpp:155-176, 178-202; src/app/main_window_menus.cpp:288-289` (SwipeMapTool::keyPressEvent / SwipeMapTool::canvasMoveEvent / QgisDesktopWindow::setupMenu)
- `src/app/main_window_misc.cpp:174-207` (QgisDesktopWindow::loadSampleData)
- `src/app/main_window_connections.cpp:366-412` (QgisDesktopWindow::onLayerTreeClicked)
- `src/app/qgsmaptooloffsetcurve.cpp:736-740` (QgsOffsetUserWidget::QgsOffsetUserWidget)
- `src/app/qgsmaptooloffsetcurve.cpp:112-118 (line 113: `const bool hasM = QgsWkbTypes::hasZ( mSourceLayer->wkbType() );`)` (QgsMapToolOffsetCurve::cadCanvasReleaseEvent)
- `src/app/shell/schema_form_builder.cpp:339-376 (Enum field build: default applied only when `prop["default"].isString()`, 356-371); values() at 789-800 then submits combo currentData` (SchemaFormBuilder::buildField (FieldKind::Enum))
- `src/gui/vector/qgsvectorlayerproperties.cpp:456` (QgsVectorLayerProperties::QgsVectorLayerProperties)
- `src/ui/qgsprojecttrustdialog.ui:243 (also src/ui/qgsexpressionstoredialogbase.ui:51; src/ui/attributeformconfig/* and src/ui/qgsattributesforminitcode.ui:23)` (mScriptPreviewEditor / mExpression / (Attributes Form tab))
- `src/app/dialogs/comparison_dialog.cpp:106-136` (ComparisonDialog::loadLayerToWidget / ComparisonDialog::onLoadLayers)
- `src/app/dialogs/stac_browser_dialog.cpp:156-185` (StacBrowserDialog::loadSelectedAsset)
- `src/app/qgsmaptoolrotatefeature.cpp:353-365 (cancel, deref at 358); 465-473 (keyReleaseEvent Escape path with no layer check); same pattern in src/app/qgsmaptoolscalefeature.cpp:306-318 (deref at 311)` (QgsMapToolRotateFeature::cancel / QgsMapToolScaleFeature::cancel)

## User impact
- Both context-menu entries are visible-but-broken (same class as #214's no-op); users get a confusing error and a phantom catalog entry per click
- Swipe keyboard affordance is dead and destructive (silently cancels the comparison); minor API dead switch
- Misleading success feedback masks broken sample datasets in the primary demo entry point
- Frequent accidental de-selection in normal legend browsing; every raster tool that keys off activeLayer then bounces the user to re-select the layer
- User preference loss + silent corruption of a digitizing conversion parameter (over-aggressive or disabled curve conversion)
- Misleading user warning only; likely inherited from upstream QGIS but divergent from the in-tree chamfer/fillet sibling
- Silent wrong-parameter submissions for affected operators; violates the schema-defaults contract
- Crash on an edge-but-real path; cheap fix.
- Degraded but non-destructive UI in three low-traffic dialogs (the Attributes Form tab is a whole missing feature surface, still non-destructive).
- UI freeze proportional to provider latency; nested event loop during wait allows reentrant input (double 加载 clicks start overlapping jobs); inconsistent with the codebase's TaskCenter/async pattern used by processing dialogs
- Unresponsive UI during STAC import; repeated clicks possible during the freeze
- Deterministic crash of the app in a layer-removal-mid-edit scenario — matches the audit focus on layer-removal crash paths

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (SHELLA-2)**: Right-click anywhere in the 视图图层 layer tree and pick 'Add Raster Layer...' or 'Add Vector Layer...'
- **Trigger (SHELLA-6)**: Activate 卷帘对比, then press Space (documented direction toggle), or call setMouseFollow(false) and move the mouse
- **Trigger (SHELLA-7)**: Help -> Load Sample Data with any unreadable/moved file in data/samples (or on a build whose sample dir has non-loadable files)
- **Trigger (SHELLA-8)**: With a raster layer selected, expand its legend in 视图图层 and click a legend class row or any group header
- **Trigger (SHELLB-2)**: Use the Offset Curve map tool and click its advanced visibility toggle
- **Trigger (SHELLB-9)**: Use Offset Curve on a PolygonZ (no M) or PointM layer
- **Trigger (SHELLB-10)**: Open a task-panel tool whose schema has a numeric enum with a non-zero default (e.g. default index/value != first item)
- **Trigger (VPATCH-4)**: Open properties of a broken vector layer (e.g., datasource deleted after add, or unknown provider).
- **Trigger (UIF-11)**: Open each dialog in the listed workflow.
- **Trigger (DLGA-10)**: Open 图层对比 from the change-detection dialog (or click 加载) with large/remote raster layers
- **Trigger (DLGB-10)**: Select a STAC item whose COG lives on a slow/unresponsive host and click 加载选中资产
- **Trigger (SHELLB-6)**: Remove the active vector layer while the rotate/scale rubber band is active, then press Escape

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (SHELLA-2)**: A file-open dialog appears and the chosen file is loaded (matching the 图层 menu Add Raster Layer... behavior)
- **Expected (SHELLA-6)**: Space toggles vertical/horizontal swipe direction (and a disabled mouse-follow freezes the divider)
- **Expected (SHELLA-7)**: Count only successful loads and report failures (e.g. '成功 X，失败 Y' like addRasterLayer at main_window_layers.cpp:205-208)
- **Expected (SHELLA-8)**: Legend/group clicks leave the active layer untouched (QGIS keeps currentLayer when interacting with legend nodes); only explicit layer selection changes it
- **Expected (SHELLB-2)**: settingsDigitizingOffsetShowAdvanced persists the toggle; curve tolerance untouched
- **Expected (SHELLB-9)**: hasM reflects QgsWkbTypes::hasM
- **Expected (SHELLB-10)**: Combo preselects the schema default
- **Expected (VPATCH-4)**: Null-check dataProvider() as the neighboring upstream code does.
- **Expected (UIF-11)**: Script preview text; expression shown; functional form-config tab.
- **Expected (DLGA-10)**: Preview render dispatched asynchronously (or rendered at reduced detail) so the dialog opens immediately
- **Expected (DLGB-10)**: Remote layer open deferred to a worker (task/QtConcurrent) with progress feedback
- **Expected (SHELLB-6)**: cancel() null-checks (as the mouse path effectively does)

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (SHELLA-2)**: No dialog; a modal warning box 'Open Raster — [display.asset_not_ready] The Data Asset is not ready for display' appears; a junk Missing asset is also registered into the Data Manager catalog and fires an autoDisplayFailed log
- **Actual (SHELLA-6)**: Space switches the map tool to pan and kills the active swipe session; mouse-follow disable is ignored (divider keeps tracking)
- **Actual (SHELLA-7)**: Status bar reports the total file count as loaded even if every load failed
- **Actual (SHELLA-8)**: Active layer is silently cleared and dependent chrome (band rail, opacity, layer status, active-raster dialogs) resets
- **Actual (SHELLB-2)**: Preference not persisted; unrelated numeric setting overwritten with a boolean
- **Actual (SHELLB-9)**: hasM mirrors hasZ; message wrong in both directions
- **Actual (SHELLB-10)**: Combo sits on the first enum item; run parameters drift from operator defaults
- **Actual (VPATCH-4)**: Unconditional dereference — nullptr crash.
- **Actual (UIF-11)**: Blank preview; blank expression display; empty Attributes Form page.
- **Actual (DLGA-10)**: GUI blocks inside waitForFinished per layer; two sequential blocking renders before the dialog is even visible
- **Actual (DLGB-10)**: GUI freezes for the duration of the vsicurl open (seconds to tens of seconds on degraded networks)
- **Actual (SHELLB-6)**: Null pointer dereference crash

## Root cause
- **SHELLA-2**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `right-click layer tree (empty area or any layer node) -> LayerTreeMenuProvider::createContextMenu -> 'Add Raster Layer...' -> ActiveViewHost::openRasterPath("") -> DataManager::registerSource("",Missing) -> QgisDisplayManager::addLayer -> 'display.asset_not_ready' failure -> QMessageBox warning`
  - *Code context*: `layer_tree_menu.cpp:29-31 `menu->addAction(QObject::tr("Add Raster Layer..."), menu, [hostPtr]() { if (hostPtr) hostPtr->openRasterPath(QString()); });` — passes an EMPTY path to ActiveViewHost::openRasterPath instead of opening QFileDialog (the main-menu equivalent QgisDesktopWindow::addRasterLayer does open a dialog). Chain: openRasterPath("") -> openSource -> DataManager::registerSource -> GdalRasterSourceProvider::resolve returns state=Missing (gdal_raster_source_provider.cpp:131-137 `if (!info.exists()...) { resolved.state = AssetState::Missing; ... return success; }`) -> asset registers and emits assetAdded -> QgisDisplayManager::addLayer rejects with 'display.asset_not_ready' -> openSource returns failure -> reportDiagnostics -> QMessageBox::warning. Same for the vector entry and for the duplicates appended to every node context menu at lines 93-99.`
- **SHELLA-6**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `toggleSwipeTool (Ctrl+Shift+S) -> SwipeMapTool active -> user presses Space -> QAction('平移', QKeySequence('Space')) shortcut wins over QgsMapCanvas keyPressEvent -> QgisDesktopWindow::panMap -> swipe tool deactivated`
  - *Code context*: `swipe_map_tool.cpp:180-183 toggles direction on Qt::Key_Space; but main_window_menus.cpp:288-289 registers `viewMenu->addAction( ic("p_n"), tr("平移"), QKeySequence("Space"), this, &QgisDesktopWindow::panMap )` on the (hidden but shortcut-active) detached menubar with default Qt::WindowShortcut context. QAction shortcuts are matched before key events reach QgsMapCanvas/the map tool, so Space always triggers panMap -> setMapTool(m_panTool), deactivating the swipe tool instead of toggling direction — the same ambiguity class as #212 (Ctrl+V Paste vs Vertex Tool). Additionally canvasMoveEvent (:155-165) never consults m_mouseFollow although the header documents 'when disabled it stays at the current position' — setMouseFollow(false) has no effect.`
- **SHELLA-7**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `帮助->加载示例数据 -> loadRasterLayer/loadVectorLayer per file (return ignored) -> statusBar 'Loaded N sample datasets'`
  - *Code context*: `main_window_misc.cpp:192-195 `for (const QFileInfo &file : files) { loadRasterLayer(file.absoluteFilePath()); loaded++; }` — the bool return of loadRasterLayer -> ActiveViewHost::openRasterPath is discarded and loaded++ runs unconditionally (same for shapefiles at :201-204). A corrupt/unsupported sample file yields an error dialog per file plus a final status line claiming 'Loaded N sample datasets' for all N files.`
- **SHELLA-8**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `layer tree click on legend/group row -> onLayerTreeClicked else-branch -> setCurrentLayer(nullptr) -> QgsMapCanvas::currentLayerChanged -> syncActiveLayerChrome -> band rail cleared / syncStatusBarLayer(无图层)`
  - *Code context*: `main_window_connections.cpp:407-411: `} else { m_mapCanvas->setCurrentLayer(nullptr); updateEditingUI(nullptr); syncStatusBarLayer(nullptr); }` — the else branch fires whenever the clicked index is not a layer node. initLayerTree (active_view_host.cpp:157-158) enables ShowLegend + ShowLegendAsTree, so raster legend class rows are real clickable rows; clicking one (e.g. to inspect/toggle a legend class) or a group header wipes currentLayer. Consequences: m_bandRail->setRasterLayer(nullptr) via the layersChanged/currentLayerChanged chrome sync (main_window_connections.cpp:62-74), status shows 无图层, opacity slider disabled, and findActiveRaster-based dialogs (ROI 均值谱, Contrast Stretch, …) then refuse to run until the user re-clicks the layer name row.`
- **SHELLB-2**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Activate Offset Curve tool -> click the advanced-options toggle (any state) -> settingsDigitizingConvertToCurveDistanceTolerance := 0.0 or 1.0; later digitizing with curve conversion enabled uses the corrupted tolerance; reopening the offset tool always shows the default advanced state`
  - *Code context*: ``const bool showAdvanced = QgsSettingsRegistryCore::settingsDigitizingOffsetShowAdvanced->value();` (line 736) restores the state, but the toggle handler writes a different key: `connect( mShowAdvancedButton, &QToolButton::clicked, this, []( const bool clicked ) { QgsSettingsRegistryCore::settingsDigitizingConvertToCurveDistanceTolerance->setValue( clicked ); } );` (line 740). Upstream QGIS writes settingsDigitizingOffsetShowAdvanced here. Two effects: (1) the advanced-panel visibility preference is read but never written, so it never persists; (2) every click stores 0.0/1.0 into the convert-to-curve distance tolerance, which is a live digitizing parameter consumed by `src/gui/maptools/qgsmaptoolcapture.cpp:390` (`linear.convertToCurves( settingsDigitizingConvertToCurveDistanceTolerance->value(), ...angleTolerance )`) — corrupting the user's configured curve-conversion tolerance to 0 or 1 after any offset-tool session.`
- **SHELLB-9**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Offset tool first click on a feature -> warning construction`
  - *Code context*: ``const bool hasZ = QgsWkbTypes::hasZ( mSourceLayer->wkbType() ); const bool hasM = QgsWkbTypes::hasZ( mSourceLayer->wkbType() );` — the second line should call QgsWkbTypes::hasM. The sibling chamfer/fillet tool implements both correctly (qgsmaptoolchamferfillet.cpp:381-382 uses hasZ then hasM), so this is a copy-paste divergence between sibling tools. Impact is confined to the warning message text ("layer X has Z/M geometry. Z/M values be set to 0...") — geometry handling itself does not depend on the flag.`
- **SHELLB-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `openTool -> panel->showTool(schema) -> SchemaFormBuilder::rebuild -> buildField(Enum) -> default skipped -> user hits Run -> formValues()/values() submits combo item 0`
  - *Code context*: ``if ( prop.isMember( "default" ) ) { if ( prop["default"].isString() ) { ...findData/setCurrentIndex... } }` — a JSON-Schema enum like {"enum":[1,2,3],"default":2} adds numeric combo data (line 350-351: `combo->addItem( QString::number( v.asDouble() ), v.asDouble() )`) but the default branch handles strings only, so the combo stays at index 0. writeFieldValue() (723-741) does handle numeric enum values, so only the initial default is lost. Every operator whose schema declares numeric enum defaults silently gets item 0 from the task panel — a form-vs-schema defaults drift, exactly the FOCUS category; string enums are unaffected.`
- **VPATCH-4**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Layer properties on a vector layer whose provider failed to construct (dataProvider() == nullptr, layer invalid but present in project/layer tree) -> ActiveViewHost::showLayerProperties has no validity gate -> ctor dereferences null.`
  - *Code context*: `Delta line: 'const bool hasSpatialIndex = mLayer->dataProvider()->capabilities() & Qgis::VectorProviderCapability::CreateSpatialIndex;' — while the surrounding upstream code null-guards the provider ('const QgsVectorDataProvider *provider = mLayer->dataProvider();' followed by checks).`
- **UIF-11**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Respective dialogs: open untrusted project with embedded scripts; save stored expression; vector layer properties -> Attributes Form tab.`
  - *Code context*: `1) qgsprojecttrustdialog.ui:243 QgsCodeEditorPython mScriptPreviewEditor - consumer qgsprojecttrustdialog.cpp:55 setText no-op -> embedded-project macro script preview always blank (readonly, cosmetic). 2) qgsexpressionstoredialogbase.ui:51 QgsCodeEditorExpression mExpression - qgsexpressionstoredialog.cpp:32 setText no-op -> dialog displays the expression being saved as empty (label/help still saved). 3) Vector Layer Properties Attributes Form tab (mOptsPage_AttributesForm, qgsvectorlayerpropertiesbase.ui:896-911; widget created qgsvectorlayerproperties.cpp:237): QgsAttributesFormProperties is replaced by the stub in antigravity_codeeditor_stubs.cpp whose ctor never calls setupUi and whose init()/apply() are empty - the tab renders a blank page and drag-and-drop form configuration silently does nothing. The attributeformconfig/*.ui forms and qgsattributesforminitcode.ui are consequently dead-loaded.`
- **DLGA-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `双视图对比… click → openComparisonPreview → setLeftLayer/setRightLayer → loadLayerToWidget ×2 → job.start(); job.waitForFinished() (GUI thread blocked in nested loop) → dialog finally shown; same again on each 加载 click`
  - *Code context*: `Lines 128-136: `QgsMapSettings mapSettings; ... QgsMapRendererParallelJob job(mapSettings); job.start(); job.waitForFinished(); const QImage image = job.renderedImage();` — a blocking nested wait in a click slot. onLoadLayers calls it for both layers back-to-back (lines 106-110), and ChangeDetectionDialog::openComparisonPreview (change_detection_dialog.cpp:260-276) calls setLeftLayer+setRightLayer before exec(), so opening the preview blocks on two full renders before the dialog appears. For slow providers (remote/WMS sources, uncached COG over network) the wait lasts the full provider timeout.`
- **DLGB-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `加载选中资产 click -> loadSelectedAsset -> QgisDesktopWindow::loadDataLayer -> ActiveViewHost::openPath -> QgsRasterLayer(/vsicurl/...) sync network open -> GUI blocked -> zoomToFullExtent -> accept()`
  - *Code context*: `'if ( !mw->loadDataLayer( vsicurl ) )' — loadDataLayer (main_window_layers.cpp:315-320) synchronously calls m_activeViewHost->openPath(filePath), which constructs a QgsRasterLayer on the '/vsicurl/https://...' URL selected by StacClient::selectCogHref. QgsRasterLayer construction performs the GDAL vsicurl header fetch (network round trips, retries on slow hosts) inline on the calling (GUI) thread; only the search itself is async via StacClient.`
- **SHELLB-6**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `start rotation (click feature) -> layer deleted (layer panel remove / project close while tool active) -> press Escape -> keyReleaseEvent -> cancel -> vlayer->selectedFeatureCount() on nullptr`
  - *Code context*: ``void QgsMapToolRotateFeature::cancel() { deleteRotationWidget(); deleteRubberband(); QgsVectorLayer *vlayer = currentVectorLayer(); if ( vlayer->selectedFeatureCount() == 0 || mAutoSetAnchorPoint ) ...` — vlayer is dereferenced unconditionally. The right-click path is safe because cadCanvasReleaseEvent checks `!vlayer` first (lines 197-206) and returns before calling cancel, but keyReleaseEvent (Escape while mRotationActive) calls cancel() directly with no check. If the edited layer was removed from the project while a rotation drag is active (mRotationActive==true, mRubberBand set), currentVectorLayer() returns nullptr -> nullptr deref -> SIGSEGV. Identical code in scalefeature cancel(). (Inherited from upstream QGIS, but a real crash path in this tree.)`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: Crash member verified. SHELLB-6: qgsmaptoolrotatefeature.cpp:353-365 cancel() dereferences currentVectorLayer() unconditionally (:358) and keyReleaseEvent Escape path (:465-473) calls cancel() with no layer check (the right-click path :197-206 checks !vlayer first); removing the edited layer mid-rotation then Escape => nullptr deref => SIGSEGV. Idential pattern in qgsmaptoolscalefeature.cpp:306-318. UIF-11 verified as real-but-cosmetic stubbed editors (qgsprojecttrustdialog.cpp:55 setText no-op; expression store dialog blank; attributes-form init tab empty).
- **Review note**: SHELLB-6 is the batch's only crash member and is the strongest justification for keeping the batch; UIF-11 is a cosmetic/degradation item.
- **Finding SHELLA-2**: `layer_tree_menu.cpp:29-31 `menu->addAction(QObject::tr("Add Raster Layer..."), menu, [hostPtr]() { if (hostPtr) hostPtr->openRasterPath(QString()); });` — passes an EMPTY path to ActiveViewHost::openRasterPath instead of opening QFileDialog (the main-menu equivalent QgisDesktopWindow::addRasterLayer does open a dialog). Chain: openRasterPath("") -> openSource -> DataManager::registerSource -> GdalRasterSourceProvider::resolve returns state=Missing (gdal_raster_source_provider.cpp:131-137 `if (!info.exists()...) { resolved.state = AssetState::Missing; ... return success; }`) -> asset registers and emits assetAdded -> QgisDisplayManager::addLayer rejects with 'display.asset_not_ready' -> openSource returns failure -> reportDiagnostics -> QMessageBox::warning. Same for the vector entry and for the duplicates appended to every node context menu at lines 93-99.`
- **Finding SHELLA-6**: `swipe_map_tool.cpp:180-183 toggles direction on Qt::Key_Space; but main_window_menus.cpp:288-289 registers `viewMenu->addAction( ic("p_n"), tr("平移"), QKeySequence("Space"), this, &QgisDesktopWindow::panMap )` on the (hidden but shortcut-active) detached menubar with default Qt::WindowShortcut context. QAction shortcuts are matched before key events reach QgsMapCanvas/the map tool, so Space always triggers panMap -> setMapTool(m_panTool), deactivating the swipe tool instead of toggling direction — the same ambiguity class as #212 (Ctrl+V Paste vs Vertex Tool). Additionally canvasMoveEvent (:155-165) never consults m_mouseFollow although the header documents 'when disabled it stays at the current position' — setMouseFollow(false) has no effect.`
- **Finding SHELLA-7**: `main_window_misc.cpp:192-195 `for (const QFileInfo &file : files) { loadRasterLayer(file.absoluteFilePath()); loaded++; }` — the bool return of loadRasterLayer -> ActiveViewHost::openRasterPath is discarded and loaded++ runs unconditionally (same for shapefiles at :201-204). A corrupt/unsupported sample file yields an error dialog per file plus a final status line claiming 'Loaded N sample datasets' for all N files.`
- **Finding SHELLA-8**: `main_window_connections.cpp:407-411: `} else { m_mapCanvas->setCurrentLayer(nullptr); updateEditingUI(nullptr); syncStatusBarLayer(nullptr); }` — the else branch fires whenever the clicked index is not a layer node. initLayerTree (active_view_host.cpp:157-158) enables ShowLegend + ShowLegendAsTree, so raster legend class rows are real clickable rows; clicking one (e.g. to inspect/toggle a legend class) or a group header wipes currentLayer. Consequences: m_bandRail->setRasterLayer(nullptr) via the layersChanged/currentLayerChanged chrome sync (main_window_connections.cpp:62-74), status shows 无图层, opacity slider disabled, and findActiveRaster-based dialogs (ROI 均值谱, Contrast Stretch, …) then refuse to run until the user re-clicks the layer name row.`
- **Finding SHELLB-2**: ``const bool showAdvanced = QgsSettingsRegistryCore::settingsDigitizingOffsetShowAdvanced->value();` (line 736) restores the state, but the toggle handler writes a different key: `connect( mShowAdvancedButton, &QToolButton::clicked, this, []( const bool clicked ) { QgsSettingsRegistryCore::settingsDigitizingConvertToCurveDistanceTolerance->setValue( clicked ); } );` (line 740). Upstream QGIS writes settingsDigitizingOffsetShowAdvanced here. Two effects: (1) the advanced-panel visibility preference is read but never written, so it never persists; (2) every click stores 0.0/1.0 into the convert-to-curve distance tolerance, which is a live digitizing parameter consumed by `src/gui/maptools/qgsmaptoolcapture.cpp:390` (`linear.convertToCurves( settingsDigitizingConvertToCurveDistanceTolerance->value(), ...angleTolerance )`) — corrupting the user's configured curve-conversion tolerance to 0 or 1 after any offset-tool session.`
- **Finding SHELLB-9**: ``const bool hasZ = QgsWkbTypes::hasZ( mSourceLayer->wkbType() ); const bool hasM = QgsWkbTypes::hasZ( mSourceLayer->wkbType() );` — the second line should call QgsWkbTypes::hasM. The sibling chamfer/fillet tool implements both correctly (qgsmaptoolchamferfillet.cpp:381-382 uses hasZ then hasM), so this is a copy-paste divergence between sibling tools. Impact is confined to the warning message text ("layer X has Z/M geometry. Z/M values be set to 0...") — geometry handling itself does not depend on the flag.`
- **Finding SHELLB-10**: ``if ( prop.isMember( "default" ) ) { if ( prop["default"].isString() ) { ...findData/setCurrentIndex... } }` — a JSON-Schema enum like {"enum":[1,2,3],"default":2} adds numeric combo data (line 350-351: `combo->addItem( QString::number( v.asDouble() ), v.asDouble() )`) but the default branch handles strings only, so the combo stays at index 0. writeFieldValue() (723-741) does handle numeric enum values, so only the initial default is lost. Every operator whose schema declares numeric enum defaults silently gets item 0 from the task panel — a form-vs-schema defaults drift, exactly the FOCUS category; string enums are unaffected.`
- **Finding VPATCH-4**: `Delta line: 'const bool hasSpatialIndex = mLayer->dataProvider()->capabilities() & Qgis::VectorProviderCapability::CreateSpatialIndex;' — while the surrounding upstream code null-guards the provider ('const QgsVectorDataProvider *provider = mLayer->dataProvider();' followed by checks).`
- **Finding UIF-11**: `1) qgsprojecttrustdialog.ui:243 QgsCodeEditorPython mScriptPreviewEditor - consumer qgsprojecttrustdialog.cpp:55 setText no-op -> embedded-project macro script preview always blank (readonly, cosmetic). 2) qgsexpressionstoredialogbase.ui:51 QgsCodeEditorExpression mExpression - qgsexpressionstoredialog.cpp:32 setText no-op -> dialog displays the expression being saved as empty (label/help still saved). 3) Vector Layer Properties Attributes Form tab (mOptsPage_AttributesForm, qgsvectorlayerpropertiesbase.ui:896-911; widget created qgsvectorlayerproperties.cpp:237): QgsAttributesFormProperties is replaced by the stub in antigravity_codeeditor_stubs.cpp whose ctor never calls setupUi and whose init()/apply() are empty - the tab renders a blank page and drag-and-drop form configuration silently does nothing. The attributeformconfig/*.ui forms and qgsattributesforminitcode.ui are consequently dead-loaded.`
- **Finding DLGA-10**: `Lines 128-136: `QgsMapSettings mapSettings; ... QgsMapRendererParallelJob job(mapSettings); job.start(); job.waitForFinished(); const QImage image = job.renderedImage();` — a blocking nested wait in a click slot. onLoadLayers calls it for both layers back-to-back (lines 106-110), and ChangeDetectionDialog::openComparisonPreview (change_detection_dialog.cpp:260-276) calls setLeftLayer+setRightLayer before exec(), so opening the preview blocks on two full renders before the dialog appears. For slow providers (remote/WMS sources, uncached COG over network) the wait lasts the full provider timeout.`
- **Finding DLGB-10**: `'if ( !mw->loadDataLayer( vsicurl ) )' — loadDataLayer (main_window_layers.cpp:315-320) synchronously calls m_activeViewHost->openPath(filePath), which constructs a QgsRasterLayer on the '/vsicurl/https://...' URL selected by StacClient::selectCogHref. QgsRasterLayer construction performs the GDAL vsicurl header fetch (network round trips, retries on slow hosts) inline on the calling (GUI) thread; only the search itself is async via StacClient.`
- **Finding SHELLB-6**: ``void QgsMapToolRotateFeature::cancel() { deleteRotationWidget(); deleteRubberband(); QgsVectorLayer *vlayer = currentVectorLayer(); if ( vlayer->selectedFeatureCount() == 0 || mAutoSetAnchorPoint ) ...` — vlayer is dereferenced unconditionally. The right-click path is safe because cadCanvasReleaseEvent checks `!vlayer` first (lines 197-206) and returns before calling cancel, but keyReleaseEvent (Escape while mRotationActive) calls cancel() directly with no check. If the edited layer was removed from the project while a rotation drag is active (mRotationActive==true, mRubberBand set), currentVectorLayer() returns nullptr -> nullptr deref -> SIGSEGV. Identical code in scalefeature cancel(). (Inherited from upstream QGIS, but a real crash path in this tree.)`

## Suggested fix
- Ensure widgets are fully initialized or stubbed safely, signals/slots are correctly connected to backend results, and UI elements do not block the main event loop.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (SHELLA-2, SHELLA-6, SHELLA-7, SHELLA-8, SHELLB-2, SHELLB-9, SHELLB-10, VPATCH-4, UIF-11, DLGA-10, DLGB-10, SHELLB-6).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- SHELLB-6 unnamed in prior issues; the audit's layer-removal crash focus; UIF-11 has no prior issue.
- Finding SHELLA-2: #214 fixed a Ribbon no-op (stop-run lambda); #236 fixed raw-pointer UAF in this same file via QPointer — the QPointer guards survive but the empty-path action argument was not part of it. No closed issue covers these menu entries
- Finding SHELLA-6: #212 fixed the Ctrl+V ambiguity (Paste vs Vertex Tool) — this is the same class but a different key/action pair not covered; #181 fixed SwipeCanvasItem bounding rect. Verified both shortcuts coexist at HEAD
- Finding SHELLA-7: #217 was Batch dialog output dir; #236 GUI minors did not touch this. No closed issue covers loadSampleData
- Finding SHELLA-8: #236/#214 do not cover layer-tree click handling; no closed issue matches. Confidence medium because impact is annoyance-level but behavior diverges from QGIS and triggers a concrete reset of dependent widgets
- Finding SHELLB-2: Not in issues-closed.txt; #236/#238 batches do not mention offset curve settings.
- Finding SHELLB-9: Not listed in issues-closed.txt.
- Finding SHELLB-10: #240/#229 are catalog/manifest drift issues, not form builder.
- Finding VPATCH-4: No closed issue covers this (#236 GUI minors list unrelated defects).
- Finding UIF-11: None: #224 mentions uncompiled test files only; no findings-*.jsonl entry covers these dialogs.
- Finding DLGA-10: #214/#218 were synchronous GDAL scans in ROI/canvas/contrast-stretch widgets — different files; the comparison-dialog waitForFinished is unreported; verified at HEAD
- Finding DLGB-10: #218 covered synchronous raster statistics — different file/path; verified at HEAD
- Finding SHELLB-6: Not in issues-closed.txt; #236 layer-menu UAF batch is about menus, not these map tools.
title: [P3][ui/interaction] Shell/UI minors batch 3: Add-Layer menu registers empty path; swipe Space hijack; sample-data success count wrong; group-click clears current layer; offset-curve setting key mixup; hasM-from-hasZ; SchemaFormBuilder enum defaults; statistics null-deref; stubbed-editor degradations

body:
## Summary
OBIA minors batch: GLCM features include NoData pixels; int index overflow past 2^31 pixels; all-band W*H float materialization; kernel/bins spinboxes no-op on flat Segment. This issue aggregates 4 related finding(s): RSHYP-3, RSHYP-4, RSHYP-5, SHELLB-4. Specifically, GLCM texture features in RsSegmentFeatures include NoData/NaN pixels that the spectral statistics explicitly exclude - NaN level computation is UB (static_cast<int>(NaN)). Specifically, RsSegmentFeatures::extract and RsSegmentMap index W*H pixel arrays with int loops and r*w+c arithmetic - silent truncation past 2^31 pixels. Specifically, RsSegmentFeatures::extract materializes every requested band as a full W*H float buffer (W*H*B*4 bytes) - OBIA GUI always passes ALL bands; ~0.9 GB at 224-band 1 MP, ~8 GB at 224-band 3000x3000.

## Area
Algorithms / Image Processing / Numerics

## Type
algorithm/numerics

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/analysis/segmentation/rs_segment_features.cpp:113-125 (any-band NoData exclusion for sum/min/max) vs 266-290 (GLCM bbox scan with label-only check); level quantization 273 and 283` (RsSegmentFeatures::extract (buildStat GLCM block))
- `src/analysis/segmentation/rs_segment_features.cpp:90 and 107 ('for ( int i = 0; i < nPixels; ++i )' with size_t nPixels), 170/203/270/281 ('labels[r * w + c]'); same pattern in rs_segment_map.cpp:160/188/233 and rs_class_raster.cpp:161/195` (RsSegmentFeatures::extract / RsSegmentMap::labelAt / RsSegmentMap::buildCoordsForSegment / RsSegmentMap::toGeoTIFF)
- `src/analysis/segmentation/rs_segment_features.cpp:43-69` (RsSegmentFeatures::extract)
- `src/app/obia/rs_obia_main_window.cpp:516-527 (runSegmentation builds segCfg without spatialRadius/rangeRadius) vs 1047-1052 (runHierarchicalSegmentation maps kernelSpin->spatialRadius, binsSpin*0.5->rangeRadius); runOtb mapping at src/app/obia/rs_obia_segmentation.cpp:24-31` (RsObiaMainWindow::runSegmentation vs runHierarchicalSegmentation)

## User impact
- Wrong object classifications for segments adjacent to NoData regions in every OBIA path (flat + hierarchical); inconsistent feature semantics vs the spectral columns of the same matrix.
- Silently wrong per-segment features / label access on >2^31-pixel scenes - same defect class accepted as #201 for kmeans.
- GUI freezes/OOM on hyperspectral OBIA - the same defect class as #204 (continuum removal full-scene materialization, fixed there) which the audit focus explicitly asks to check elsewhere; this instance remains.
- Misleading parameter UI on the primary OBIA segmentation action; silent divergence from the hierarchy path

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (RSHYP-3)**: Any segment touching a NoData/NaN pixel (segment maps label them 0 only where the segmenter saw the sentinel; per-band NoData of bands other than band 1 and NaN float products are not masked by the segmenter at all) in the 8 GLCM columns that RsFeatureSelection enables by default.
- **Trigger (RSHYP-4)**: Scenes larger than 2^31 pixels (e.g. 46342x46342, 50000x45000 Sentinel-2 mosaics) on machines whose RAM satisfies the >=8.6 GB-per-band float allocation that precedes the loops.
- **Trigger (RSHYP-5)**: OBIA inspect/classify on a multi-band or hyperspectral raster in the OBIA window (band selection is not offered): 224-band 1024x1024 -> 224 * 4 MB ~ 900 MB RSS in one call; 224-band 3000x3000 -> ~8 GB (OOM-class); GLCM then re-scans every segment bbox per band.
- **Trigger (SHELLB-4)**: OTB installed; change Segments kernel/bins spinboxes; press Segment

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (RSHYP-3)**: GLCM pair accumulation skips the same pixels the mean/stddev/min/max accumulators skip (any-band NoData/NaN rule), keeping spectral and texture features consistent.
- **Expected (RSHYP-4)**: size_t/qsizetype loop variables and 64-bit index arithmetic, matching the size_t nPixels used for allocation.
- **Expected (RSHYP-5)**: Sequential per-band streaming (read band -> accumulate stats+GLCM -> release), as already done inside RsSimpleSegmenter::segmentMultiBand (one band resident at a time) - the kernel needs no cross-band buffer.
- **Expected (SHELLB-4)**: Spinbox values influence segmentation (as they do via Hierarchy)

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (RSHYP-3)**: Sentinel/NaN pixels are quantized into levels 0..15 and pollute contrast/energy/homogeneity/correlation; NaN additionally makes the level computation UB. Segments near NoData get systematically wrong texture features while their mean/stddev look correct (also rectangularity: area excludes NoData pixels but bbox includes them).
- **Actual (RSHYP-4)**: Accumulation silently covers only the first 2^31 pixels (or traps under UB); label writes/reads use overflowed int indices.
- **Actual (RSHYP-5)**: All bands resident for the whole call; peak RSS scales linearly with band count on the GUI thread path.
- **Actual (SHELLB-4)**: Identical result for any kernel/bins value (only minRegionSize has an effect on the OTB path)

## Root cause
- **RSHYP-3**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `OBIA GUI: src/app/obia/rs_obia_main_window.cpp:586/957/1133 (RsSegmentFeatures::extract with allBandIndices()) and src/app/obia/rs_obia_task.cpp:95 -> features feed RsSegmentFeatures::toFeatureMatrix -> RsObjectClassify::classify / RsHierarchyFeatures::buildFeatureMatrix (glcmContrast/Correlation/Energy/Homogeneity are 4 of the per-band feature groups enabled by default in RsFeatureSelection)`
  - *Code context*: `The accumulator loop skips pixels nodata in ANY band: 'bool isPixelNodata = false; for ( int b = 0; b < nBands; ++b ) { const float v = bandData[b][i]; if ( std::isnan( v ) || ( hasNoData[b] && static_cast<double>( v ) == bandNoData[b] ) ) { isPixelNodata = true; break; } } if ( isPixelNodata ) continue;' (113-125). The GLCM loop only checks segment membership: 'for ( int r = box.minR; r <= box.maxR; ++r ) ... if ( labels[r * w + c] != segId ) continue; const int level1 = std::clamp( static_cast<int>( ( bandData[b][r * w + c] - minV ) / rangeV * ( nLevels - 1 ) ), 0, nLevels - 1 );' (266-273) - a pixel that is NoData in band b still contributes a level pair with its neighbor. With NaN the expression is NaN and 'static_cast<int>( NaN )' is undefined behavior (x86-64 typically yields INT_MIN, clamped to 0); with sentinel -9999 the level is clamped to 0, fabricating high-contrast pairs against valid neighbors.`
- **RSHYP-4**: confirmed (latent >2^31)
  - *Callchain*: `OBIA GUI and tasks call extract() with allBandIndices() (rs_obia_main_window.cpp:957/586/1133, rs_obia_task.cpp:95); toGeoTIFF/labelAt are on every segment-map write/read path`
  - *Code context*: `nPixels is computed correctly as size_t ('const size_t nPixels = static_cast<size_t>(w) * static_cast<size_t>(h);', line 40) but both full-image scans iterate an int: 'for ( int i = 0; i < nPixels; ++i ) maxLabel = std::max( maxLabel, labels[i] );' (90) and the accumulator loop (107). When nPixels > 2^31, i overflows at INT_MAX (UB); with the usual wrap the comparison (size_t)i < nPixels goes false and the loop silently stops at 2^31 pixels - maxLabel and all per-segment statistics are computed from only the first half of the scene. 'labels[r * w + c]' (170 etc.) and 'const int rowBase = r * mWidth;' (rs_segment_map.cpp:160) overflow for the same sizes.`
- **RSHYP-5**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `RsObiaMainWindow::inspectSelectedSegment / segmentation task completion (957, 586) and hierarchy build (1070, 1133), RsObiaTask (rs_obia_task.cpp:95) -> RsSegmentFeatures::extract -> per-band accumulators + per-band GLCM`
  - *Code context*: `'QVector<QVector<float>> bandData( nBands ); ... for ( int b = 0; b < nBands; ++b ) { bandData[b].resize( nPixels ); CPLErr err = GDALRasterIO( band, GF_Read, 0, 0, w, h, bandData[b].data(), w, h, GDT_Float32, 0, 0 ); ... }' (43-61) reads and retains ALL bands simultaneously although the GLCM/statistics kernel is strictly per-band, and the OBIA main window has no band selection: 'mSegStats = RsSegmentFeatures::extract( mRasterPath, mSegMap, allBandIndices() );' (rs_obia_main_window.cpp:957; allBandIndices() at 935-940 appends every band; hierarchy path 1070/1133 same). Complexity: memory O(W*H*B*4) + GLCM O(B * sum-of-segment-bbox-areas).`
- **SHELLB-4**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Segment button -> runSegmentation -> segCfg{spatialRadius=5(default), rangeRadius=15(default)} -> RsObiaSegmentation::run -> runOtb -> RsOtbSegmenter with hardcoded radii`
  - *Code context*: `runSegmentation sets only `segCfg.smoothKernel/quantizeBins/minRegionSize` from kernelSpin/binsSpin/minRegionSpin; spatialRadius and rangeRadius keep their struct defaults (5 / 15, rs_obia_segmentation.h:18-19). With OTB available (preferOtb=true, the default: RsObiaSegmentation::isOtbAvailable), runOtb uses cfg.spatialRadius/cfg.rangeRadius for the MeanShift spec and only minRegionSize from the UI — so kernelSpin (tooltip: "平滑核大小 3–21。越大对象边界越粗…", presented as a live parameter) and binsSpin have zero effect on the default path. runHierarchicalSegmentation on the same two spinboxes DOES map them (spatialRadius=kernelSpin, rangeRadius=binsSpin*0.5), so identical UI controls produce different behavior between the two adjacent buttons — a copy-paste divergence between sibling branches.`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: RSHYP-4 verified: rs_segment_features.cpp:40 computes nPixels as size_t but both full-image scans iterate `for (int i = 0; i < nPixels; ++i)` (:90,:107) and index `labels[r*w+c]` with ints (:170,:203,:270,:281); over INT_MAX i wraps (UB) and the loop silently stops at 2^31 pixels — same accepted #201 defect class (kmeans gate); frame <-> lat. RSALGO-numerics family corroborated. RSHYP-3 verified (GLCM bbox scan in rs_segment_features.cpp:266-290 has label-only filter; level computation `static_cast<int>(NaN)` is UB). RSHYP-5 verified (extract() materializes all requested bands W*H*B; OBIA GUI passes all bands).
- **Review note**: RSHYP-4 requires >2^31-pixel scenes AND sufficient RAM for the preceding >8.6GB-per-band-float allocations — latent but same class already accepted as #201; keep.
- **Finding RSHYP-3**: `The accumulator loop skips pixels nodata in ANY band: 'bool isPixelNodata = false; for ( int b = 0; b < nBands; ++b ) { const float v = bandData[b][i]; if ( std::isnan( v ) || ( hasNoData[b] && static_cast<double>( v ) == bandNoData[b] ) ) { isPixelNodata = true; break; } } if ( isPixelNodata ) continue;' (113-125). The GLCM loop only checks segment membership: 'for ( int r = box.minR; r <= box.maxR; ++r ) ... if ( labels[r * w + c] != segId ) continue; const int level1 = std::clamp( static_cast<int>( ( bandData[b][r * w + c] - minV ) / rangeV * ( nLevels - 1 ) ), 0, nLevels - 1 );' (266-273) - a pixel that is NoData in band b still contributes a level pair with its neighbor. With NaN the expression is NaN and 'static_cast<int>( NaN )' is undefined behavior (x86-64 typically yields INT_MIN, clamped to 0); with sentinel -9999 the level is clamped to 0, fabricating high-contrast pairs against valid neighbors.`
- **Finding RSHYP-4**: `nPixels is computed correctly as size_t ('const size_t nPixels = static_cast<size_t>(w) * static_cast<size_t>(h);', line 40) but both full-image scans iterate an int: 'for ( int i = 0; i < nPixels; ++i ) maxLabel = std::max( maxLabel, labels[i] );' (90) and the accumulator loop (107).
