When nPixels > 2^31, i overflows at INT_MAX (UB); with the usual wrap the comparison (size_t)i < nPixels goes false and the loop silently stops at 2^31 pixels - maxLabel and all per-segment statistics are computed from only the first half of the scene. 'labels[r * w + c]' (170 etc.) and 'const int rowBase = r * mWidth;' (rs_segment_map.cpp:160) overflow for the same sizes.`
- **Finding RSHYP-5**: `'QVector<QVector<float>> bandData( nBands ); ... for ( int b = 0; b < nBands; ++b ) { bandData[b].resize( nPixels ); CPLErr err = GDALRasterIO( band, GF_Read, 0, 0, w, h, bandData[b].data(), w, h, GDT_Float32, 0, 0 ); ... }' (43-61) reads and retains ALL bands simultaneously although the GLCM/statistics kernel is strictly per-band, and the OBIA main window has no band selection: 'mSegStats = RsSegmentFeatures::extract( mRasterPath, mSegMap, allBandIndices() );' (rs_obia_main_window.cpp:957; allBandIndices() at 935-940 appends every band; hierarchy path 1070/1133 same). Complexity: memory O(W*H*B*4) + GLCM O(B * sum-of-segment-bbox-areas).`
- **Finding SHELLB-4**: `runSegmentation sets only `segCfg.smoothKernel/quantizeBins/minRegionSize` from kernelSpin/binsSpin/minRegionSpin; spatialRadius and rangeRadius keep their struct defaults (5 / 15, rs_obia_segmentation.h:18-19). With OTB available (preferOtb=true, the default: RsObiaSegmentation::isOtbAvailable), runOtb uses cfg.spatialRadius/cfg.rangeRadius for the MeanShift spec and only minRegionSize from the UI — so kernelSpin (tooltip: "平滑核大小 3–21。越大对象边界越粗…", presented as a live parameter) and binsSpin have zero effect on the default path. runHierarchicalSegmentation on the same two spinboxes DOES map them (spatialRadius=kernelSpin, rangeRadius=binsSpin*0.5), so identical UI controls produce different behavior between the two adjacent buttons — a copy-paste divergence between sibling branches.`

## Suggested fix
- Correct the mathematical formulas, coordinate system transforms, and NoData boundary conditions to align with standard GIS conventions (Horn 1981, GDAL, IEEE-754).

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (RSHYP-3, RSHYP-4, RSHYP-5, SHELLB-4).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- RSHYP-4 cited #201 as precedent; no prior GLCM/RSHYP-5 issues.
- Finding RSHYP-3: #230 covers the rs:segment_stats OPERATOR including NoData in means and explicitly names RsSegmentFeatures as the correct reference - the GLCM defect in RsSegmentFeatures itself is new. No closed issue mentions GLCM.
- Finding RSHYP-4: #201 fixed the kmeans reservoir gate only (src/processing); this occurrence in the analysis layer is unfixed. Not covered by any other closed issue.
- Finding RSHYP-5: #204 fixed continuum removal only (per focus note); no closed issue covers RsSegmentFeatures memory. New finding.
- Finding SHELLB-4: Not covered by closed issues; #240 is about MCP catalog categories, unrelated.
title: [P3][algorithm/numerics] OBIA minors batch: GLCM features include NoData pixels; int index overflow past 2^31 pixels; all-band W*H float materialization; kernel/bins spinboxes no-op on flat Segment

body:
## Summary
Classification minors batch: tile write/close errors ignored (disk-full => ok=true); sidecar validation always empty; predict-only band check counts-only; extraction rasterize without CRS check; post-process drops NoData=0; unbounded ROI extraction memory. This issue aggregates 6 related finding(s): RSCLS-5, RSCLS-6, RSCLS-7, RSCLS-8, RSCLS-9, RSCLS-10. Specifically, Pipeline ignores tile write and dataset-close errors — disk-full/IO failure produces result.ok=true with a truncated or zero-filled output. Specifically, Model sidecar's validation section is always empty — saveModelSidecar runs before the holdout accuracy it is documented to embed is computed. Specifically, Predict-only band-compatibility check compares only counts — a model trained on a same-size different band set is applied to misaligned features silently.

## Area
Error Handling / Exception Safety

## Type
error-handling

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/analysis/classification/rs_classification_pipeline.cpp:884-892 (unchecked GF_Write), 906-909 (unchecked GDALClose flush)` (RsClassificationPipeline::run tile loop)
- `src/analysis/classification/rs_classification_pipeline.cpp:382-410 (save with result.accuracy still default) vs 473-511 (accuracy computed afterwards)` (RsClassificationPipeline::run / RsClassificationPipeline::saveModelSidecar)
- `src/analysis/classification/rs_classification_pipeline.cpp:210-237` (RsClassificationPipeline::run (predict-only model check))
- `src/analysis/classification/rs_training_data_extraction.cpp:307-423 (extractFromVector -> collectPixels at 412 rasterizes raw OGR geometry via RsPixelRasterizer with the raster GT)` (RsTrainingDataExtraction::extractFromVector)
- `src/app/classification/rs_post_process_task.cpp:239-249 (saveLabelRaster called with quiet_NaN); rs_analysis loadLabelRaster (rs_post_process.cpp:399-456) never reads the source band NoData` (RsPostProcessTask::run / RsPostProcess::saveLabelRaster)
- `src/app/classification/qgsclassificationmainwindow.cpp:2212-2217 (Options with maxSamplesPerClass left 0 = unlimited; no UI control exists); src/analysis/classification/rs_training_data_extraction.cpp:82-130 (full X create)` (QgsClassificationMainWindow::buildTrainingData -> RsTrainingDataExtraction::extract/buildMatrices)

## User impact
- Silent corrupted output presented as a successful classification; downstream post-process/polygonize consumes the truncated map.
- Documented sidecar contract broken; model consumers (predict-only loads, RsClassifierLoadDialog) never see training-time validation numbers.
- Silently wrong predictions in a scenario the check explicitly claims to guard; compounded by unscaled models (scaler only checks width).
- Wrong or unusable training data on a CRS mismatch; #194's fix (0169bd7eac) touched 19 files, none in classification.
- Downstream contract violation consistent with the class of #202, but on the classification post-process path which that fix did not touch.
- Deterministic crash on plausible user actions (whole-region ROI); complexity O(ROIpixels x bands) memory with no bound.

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (RSCLS-5)**: Output on a full or quota-exhausted volume (typical for compressed whole-scene class maps) mid-run.
- **Trigger (RSCLS-6)**: Train + save model with a holdout split (operator: modelOut + testSplit=0.3); inspect the .meta.json.
- **Trigger (RSCLS-7)**: User selects 3 bands on a new scene where the model was trained on a different 3-band combination (or reordered).
- **Trigger (RSCLS-8)**: Training polygons in EPSG:4326 over a UTM raster (or any CRS mismatch with geographic overlap): tiny/no pixels rasterize inside the raster extent.
- **Trigger (RSCLS-9)**: Run any post-process on a normal classified raster (which declares NoData=unclassified) and inspect the output's band NoData, or feed the output to a downstream mean/mask operator.
- **Trigger (RSCLS-10)**: 3000x3000-pixel rectangle ROI on a 224-band scene: 9e6 samples x 224 x 4B ~= 8.1 GB for X alone (plus ~150 MB index structures and 2 more copies after the split); even 1 MP x 224 bands ~= 0.9 GB before training starts.

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (RSCLS-5)**: Write/close failure reported (Error::RasterWriteFailed) and partial output removed.
- **Expected (RSCLS-6)**: validation.overallAccuracy/kappa/perClass populated from the holdout run.
- **Expected (RSCLS-7)**: Reject when band identities differ from the sidecar features array (both are available).
- **Expected (RSCLS-8)**: CRS comparison + transform (or hard error) before rasterization, as done for the GUI path via RsRoiIO::load.
- **Expected (RSCLS-9)**: Source NoData=0 re-declared on the post-processed output (or an explicit unclassified policy).
- **Expected (RSCLS-10)**: A per-class cap (like the operator's maxSamplesPerClass=5000) or incremental/streaming extraction for the GUI path.

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (RSCLS-5)**: ok=true, 'Classification completed' logged, layer added to the map; unwritten tiles read back as NoData/0.
- **Actual (RSCLS-6)**: The 'validation' key is never emitted (accuracy.classIds empty at save time), so a later loadModelSidecar cannot restore validation metrics.
- **Actual (RSCLS-7)**: Prediction proceeds; feature columns fed to the model correspond to different spectral bands; garbage class map with ok=true.
- **Actual (RSCLS-8)**: Either a confusing 'No valid training pixels' failure or, when footprints partially overlap, a training set sampled from the wrong locations.
- **Actual (RSCLS-9)**: Output declares no NoData; 0/unclassified pixels are treated as class-0 data by downstream statistics, masks, and polygonize (background polygons).
- **Actual (RSCLS-10)**: Unbounded allocation on the GUI thread path; process aborts (OOM) or freezes the machine on hyperspectral scenes.

## Root cause
- **RSCLS-5**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `GUI Apply / operator -> pipeline tile loop -> band write; GTiff buffers tiles until cache flush/close, where ENOSPC surfaces as CE_Failure`
  - *Code context*: `dstDs->GetRasterBand( 1 )->RasterIO( GF_Write, dstX, dstY, tw, th, outBuf.data(), tw, th, GDT_Int32, 0, 0 ); — return value discarded (contrast the checked GF_Read at lines 746-754 and the checked write in RsPostProcess::saveLabelRaster:548).`
- **RSCLS-6**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Apply/operator with modelSavePath set and testSplit>0 -> model saved at 0.30 progress milestone, accuracy computed after`
  - *Code context*: `if ( !saveModelSidecar( config.modelSavePath, config.methodName, config.scaler, config.classColors, config.bandIndices, result.accuracy ) ) ... then later result.accuracy = RsAccuracyAssessment::compute( yt, yp ); — header lines 89-90 promise 'holdout validation metrics' in the sidecar.`
- **RSCLS-7**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:supervised_classification modelIn with bands=[1,2,3] vs model trained on [3,2,1]/[2,4,6]`
  - *Code context*: `if ( !sidecarFeatures.isEmpty() && !config.bandIndices.isEmpty() && sidecarFeatures.size() != config.bandIndices.size() ) { ...error... } — the error text ('Select the same bands before applying the model') shows identity was intended, but element-wise equality is never tested; scaler band-count check also passes since sizes match.`
- **RSCLS-8**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:supervised_classification(training=...) -> pipeline -> extractFromVector; GUI ROI shapefile path is safe (RsRoiIO::load transforms to target CRS) but the operator path is not`
  - *Code context*: `No QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem/OGRSpatialReference comparison anywhere in the file; geometries are consumed in whatever CRS the layer declares, directly in raster pixel space; the operator's only hint is the error string 'No valid training pixels extracted (check CRS overlap and classField)'.`
- **RSCLS-9**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `RsClassificationPipeline writes class map with NoData=0 (writeOutputNodata default true) -> GUI Sieve/Majority/Clump/Recode/merge-class dialog -> RsPostProcessTask -> output GTiff with no NoData value`
  - *Code context*: `// NaN → no GDAL NoData marker (caller preserves the source's semantics). if ( !RsPostProcess::saveLabelRaster( ..., std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(), &err ) ) — but no caller preserves anything: loadLabelRaster returns only labels/gt/wkt, and saveLabelRaster skips SetNoDataValue when NaN (rs_post_process.cpp:573-574).`
- **RSCLS-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Rectangle/polygon ROI over a large area (magic wand is capped at 513x513, manual tools are not) -> buildTrainingData on Apply/Preview/CV`
  - *Code context*: `RsTrainingDataExtraction::Options options; options.ignore = currentIgnoreOptions(); options.minSamples = 10; — grep: the GUI never sets maxSamplesPerClass anywhere (operator defaults to 5000). buildMatrices: out.X.create( samples.size(), B, CV_32F ) plus a QPair sample list and byRow QHash over every pixel; stratifiedSplit then clones X into train+test.`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: Highest-risk members verified. RSCLS-5: rs_classification_pipeline.cpp:884-889 discards GF_Write return values, :906-909 GDALClose without checking flush error, then `result.ok = true` — disk-full/IO failure yields a truncated/zero-filled map presented as success (contrast with the checked GF_Read at :746-754 and RsPostProcess::saveLabelRaster:548). RSCLS-10: qgsclassificationmainwindow.cpp:2212-2217 builds RsTrainingDataExtraction::Options with maxSamplesPerClass left at its default 0 (unlimited) — no UI control sets it (operator default is 5000) — and buildMatrices does out.X.create(samples.size(), B) on every ROI pixel x band (:82-130); 3000x3000 x 224-band ~8.1GB X before training, deterministic OOM on plausible actions. RSCLS-9 verified (saveLabelRaster called with quiet_NaN so no GDAL NoData marker is set; unclassified 0 pixels become valid downstream).
- **Review note**: None. P3 retained.
- **Finding RSCLS-5**: `dstDs->GetRasterBand( 1 )->RasterIO( GF_Write, dstX, dstY, tw, th, outBuf.data(), tw, th, GDT_Int32, 0, 0 ); — return value discarded (contrast the checked GF_Read at lines 746-754 and the checked write in RsPostProcess::saveLabelRaster:548).`
- **Finding RSCLS-6**: `if ( !saveModelSidecar( config.modelSavePath, config.methodName, config.scaler, config.classColors, config.bandIndices, result.accuracy ) ) ... then later result.accuracy = RsAccuracyAssessment::compute( yt, yp ); — header lines 89-90 promise 'holdout validation metrics' in the sidecar.`
- **Finding RSCLS-7**: `if ( !sidecarFeatures.isEmpty() && !config.bandIndices.isEmpty() && sidecarFeatures.size() != config.bandIndices.size() ) { ...error... } — the error text ('Select the same bands before applying the model') shows identity was intended, but element-wise equality is never tested; scaler band-count check also passes since sizes match.`
- **Finding RSCLS-8**: `No QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem/OGRSpatialReference comparison anywhere in the file; geometries are consumed in whatever CRS the layer declares, directly in raster pixel space; the operator's only hint is the error string 'No valid training pixels extracted (check CRS overlap and classField)'.`
- **Finding RSCLS-9**: `// NaN → no GDAL NoData marker (caller preserves the source's semantics). if ( !RsPostProcess::saveLabelRaster( ..., std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(), &err ) ) — but no caller preserves anything: loadLabelRaster returns only labels/gt/wkt, and saveLabelRaster skips SetNoDataValue when NaN (rs_post_process.cpp:573-574).`
- **Finding RSCLS-10**: `RsTrainingDataExtraction::Options options; options.ignore = currentIgnoreOptions(); options.minSamples = 10; — grep: the GUI never sets maxSamplesPerClass anywhere (operator defaults to 5000). buildMatrices: out.X.create( samples.size(), B, CV_32F ) plus a QPair sample list and byRow QHash over every pixel; stratifiedSplit then clones X into train+test.`

## Suggested fix
- Implement robust error reporting, return explicit error codes/exceptions, and prevent silent failures or unhandled exception aborts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (RSCLS-5, RSCLS-6, RSCLS-7, RSCLS-8, RSCLS-9, RSCLS-10).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- RSCLS-10 touches #259 (per-tile discard) but is a distinct unbounded-memory defect; no prior issues for the others.
- Finding RSCLS-5: issues-closed.txt: #227 'partial outputs left behind' (opposite failure mode), #285 (pre-create deletion) — no closed issue covers unchecked write results in the pipeline.
- Finding RSCLS-6: grep issues-closed.txt for sidecar/validation: #242 (scaler missing, different); no closed issue on validation-in-sidecar ordering.
- Finding RSCLS-7: issues-closed.txt #242/#255/#186: none cover band-identity validation; check exists but is count-only.
- Finding RSCLS-8: #194 closed by 0169bd7eac; git show --stat verified no classification file touched; rs:supervised_classification unaffected at HEAD.
- Finding RSCLS-9: #202 closed by b3fe107887 covers SAM/RX/mosaic outputs; #190/#193 other operators; no closed issue covers rs_post_process_task NoData propagation.
- Finding RSCLS-10: issues-closed.txt: #201/#200 kmeans reservoir gate (operator path), #256/#214 GUI scan perf — none cover the uncapped GUI extraction memory.
title: [P3][error-handling] Classification minors batch: tile write/close errors ignored (disk-full => ok=true); sidecar validation always empty; predict-only band check counts-only; extraction rasterize without CRS check; post-process drops NoData=0; unbounded ROI extraction memory

body:
## Summary
Algorithms numerics minors batch: NaN-neighbor terrain edges; cellSize ignores |gt[5]|; QVector<bool> cross-thread writes; ROI means include NoData; GS through-origin coefficients; 4-band fusion cap + NN upsample; computeStats skips inf; histogram-equalize normalization; Otsu bin/threshold grid mismatch. This issue aggregates 9 related finding(s): RSALGO-9, RSALGO-10, RSALGO-12, RSALGO-13, RSALGO-14, RSALGO-15, RSALGO-16, RSALGO-17, RSALGO-18. Specifically, slope/aspect/hillshade detect NoData neighbors only via == nodata - NaN neighbors bypass the edge-fallback and NaN-poison the Horn sums. Specifically, Terrain cellSize taken from |gt[1]| only - Y pixel size ignored, slope/aspect wrong on non-square DEMs. Specifically, ChunkedProcessor::process writes QVector<bool> results from concurrent worker threads - bit-packed shared words are a data race (UB).

## Area
Algorithms / Image Processing / Numerics

## Type
algorithm/numerics

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/processing/algorithms/terrain_analysis.cpp:66-67, 94-95, 176-177, 263-264` (TerrainAnalysis::slope/aspect/hillshade (processBorder/processInterior hasNodata checks))
- `src/operators/rs/rs_terrain_analysis_operator.cpp:106-111` (RsTerrainAnalysisOperator::run (cellSize derivation), TerrainAnalysis kernels take a single cellSize)
- `src/processing/algorithms/chunked_processor.cpp:50, 60-81` (ChunkedProcessor::process)
- `src/processing/algorithms/spectral_roi.cpp:121-135` (SpectralRoiProfile::meanSpectrum)
- `src/processing/algorithms/image_fusion.cpp:1338-1352 (streaming) vs 556-603 (in-memory)` (ImageFusion::processNativeFusion(method=gram_schmidt) vs ImageFusion::gramSchmidtFusion)
- `src/processing/algorithms/image_fusion.cpp:739, 805-815` (ImageFusion::processNativeFusion (nMsBands cap; readMsWindow))
- `src/processing/algorithms/math_utils.cpp:32-76, 81-138` (MathUtils::computeStats / computeStatsWithNodata)
- `src/processing/algorithms/image_enhancement.cpp:119-142` (ImageEnhancement::histogramEqualize)
- `src/processing/algorithms/change_detection.cpp:158-170, 213` (ChangeDetection::otsuThreshold / otsuThresholdFromHistogram)

## User impact
- Mixed sentinels (-9999 vs NaN) in one output plus undeclared NoData (see RSALGO-4); edge statistics differ between terrain products on the same DEM.
- Slope magnitude and aspect direction biased on anisotropic grids; silent because outputs remain plausible-looking.
- Latent correctness hazard in the shared parallel primitive; TSan reports under any multi-chunk failure.
- Wrong mean spectra feed the spectral library matching workflow (SAM/SID against polluted references); same class as #230 segment-stats means.
- Degraded spectral fidelity in the operator-facing GS path plus an inconsistency between the two GS implementations; fused colors drift toward the pan.
- Data loss on multi-band products; measurable fused-image quality loss vs bilinear upsample; user gets no signal that 4+ bands were discarded.
- Whole-band display/statistics collapse from one bad pixel; inconsistent validity semantics across the math utilities.
- Systematically flatter equalization than the reference implementations; subtle but visible contrast loss on dark-scene bands.
- Small systematic bias in reported SICNU_CHANGE_THRESHOLD and the derived change mask; inconsistencies with the percentile variant on identical histograms.

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (RSALGO-9)**: DEM whose band NoData is NaN (common for Float32 DEM exports) with interior NaN regions or border pixels
- **Trigger (RSALGO-10)**: DEM with non-square pixels (warped/resampled products, lat-lon tiles with differing dLat/dLon spacing, aggregated products like MODIS 250m x 500m bands)
- **Trigger (RSALGO-12)**: Any future callback returning false (or checking the return) from a chunk running concurrently with another chunk in the same 32-index window
- **Trigger (RSALGO-13)**: Draw an ROI partially over NoData fill on any multispectral raster and read the mean spectrum
- **Trigger (RSALGO-14)**: Gram-Schmidt pan-sharpening on DN-scale MS/pan (the normal case)
- **Trigger (RSALGO-15)**: Fusion with >4-band MS input, or any pan/MS resolution ratio >1 (the advertised heterogeneous-resolution path)
- **Trigger (RSALGO-16)**: Any input containing +/-inf pixels (e.g. unguarded division upstream, Float32 saturation) fed to a stddev stretch or change statistics
- **Trigger (RSALGO-17)**: Histogram-equalization stretch on any band whose lowest populated bin holds a non-trivial fraction of pixels (typical: shadow/water-heavy scenes, clipped products)
- **Trigger (RSALGO-18)**: Any Otsu auto-threshold change detection (compare against percentile on the same magnitude raster)

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (RSALGO-9)**: NaN neighbor treated as missing -> fallback dzdx=(f-d)/2cs formula, out = nodata sentinel for missing centers
- **Expected (RSALGO-10)**: Separate cellSizeX/cellSizeY (gt[1], |gt[5]|) as in GDAL gdaldem (-s accepts both via geotransform)
- **Expected (RSALGO-12)**: Thread-safe per-chunk status (std::vector<std::atomic<bool>> or per-thread results + merge)
- **Expected (RSALGO-13)**: NoData-sentinel pixels excluded like NaN pixels
- **Expected (RSALGO-14)**: Centered coefficient (covariance/variance) as used by the in-memory variant
- **Expected (RSALGO-15)**: All MS bands fused (or an explicit band-selection parameter); bilinear/cubic MS resample
- **Expected (RSALGO-16)**: Non-finite (NaN and inf) values excluded, matching DarkObjectStats' isfinite convention
- **Expected (RSALGO-17)**: out = (cdf - cdf_min)/(N - cdf_min) * 255, darkest populated value -> 0, brightest -> 255
- **Expected (RSALGO-18)**: Threshold placed at the center of the accumulated histogram bin: min + (b+0.5)*range/(bins-1)

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (RSALGO-9)**: NaN enters (c2+2f+i)-(a+2d+g) -> out=NaN (a second, undeclared sentinel) instead of -9999; results inconsistent with tri/tpi/roughness
- **Actual (RSALGO-10)**: Single |gt[1]| for both axes
- **Actual (RSALGO-12)**: UB data race on shared bit words; unreliable failure propagation
- **Actual (RSALGO-13)**: Sentinel values averaged into the per-band mean/stddev
- **Actual (RSALGO-14)**: Through-origin coefficient biased by band means; different results from the in-memory API for identical inputs
- **Actual (RSALGO-15)**: Bands 5..N silently dropped; nearest-neighbor replication introduces blocky artifacts that the pan substitution then sharpens
- **Actual (RSALGO-16)**: min/max/mean/stddev become inf or -inf; linear stretch degenerates to a flat output
- **Actual (RSALGO-17)**: out = cdf*255; output dynamic range compressed by cdf_min*255 and never reaches 0
- **Actual (RSALGO-18)**: min + (b+0.5)*range/bins - biased low by up to 0.4% of the magnitude range

## Root cause
- **RSALGO-9**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:terrain_analysis -> TerrainAnalysis::slope (rs_terrain_analysis_operator.cpp:144)`
  - *Code context*: `hasNodata checks are `a == nodata || b == nodata || ...` with no std::isnan on neighbors (the center pixel does get `std::isnan(z)` at :55/:83). tri/tpi/roughness DO check `v == nodata || std::isnan(v)` (:332, :383, :434). The operator passes nodata=-9999 whenever the band NoData is NaN (`if (hasNodata && std::isfinite(dsNodata))`, rs_terrain_analysis_operator.cpp:119) so float DEMs with NaN NoData produce NaN results through the Horn sum instead of the intended neighbor-fallback, and the output mixes NaN pixels with -9999 pixels.`
- **RSALGO-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:terrain_analysis -> TerrainAnalysis::slope/aspect/hillshade`
  - *Code context*: ``const std::array<double,6> gt = ds.geoTransform(); if (std::abs(gt[1]) > 1e-7) cellSize = static_cast<float>(std::abs(gt[1]));` - gt[5] (Y resolution) never consulted; the kernels accept one scalar used for both dzdx and dzdy (terrain_analysis.cpp:47-49). Horn slope magnitude = atan(sqrt((dz/dx)^2+(dz/dy)^2)); with cellSizeX != |gt[5]| the steeper-axis gradient is scaled by the wrong factor (e.g. 1m x 2m pixels -> dzdy halves -> slope underestimated up to ~2x, aspect rotated toward the X axis).`
- **RSALGO-12**: confirmed (latent data race)
  - *Callchain*: `ImageEnhancement::leeFilter/enhancedLeeFilter/frostFilter/kuanFilter/gammaMapFilter -> ChunkedProcessor::process`
  - *Code context*: ``QVector<bool> results(m_chunks.size());` then inside QtConcurrent::blockingMap lambda `results[idx] = callback(...)` from multiple pool threads. QVector<bool> packs 32+ booleans per word; distinct indices in the same word race on load-modify-store (not std::vector<bool> style atomicity, no synchronization). The check loop `for (bool r : results) if (!r) return false;` may observe lost updates. Currently latent: the only users (ImageEnhancement speckle filters, image_enhancement.cpp:667/729/806/885/956) always `return true` and ignore process()'s return value, so no functional impact today.`
- **RSALGO-13**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs_roi_spectrum_tool (src/app/map_tools/rs_roi_spectrum_tool.cpp:96) -> SpectralRoiProfile::meanSpectrum -> spectral workbench / library matching`
  - *Code context*: `Per-band accumulation filters only `if (!std::isfinite(value)) continue;` - the band's declared NoData sentinel (read via GDALGetRasterNoDataValue is never done here) is included in sum/sumSq/validCount. An ROI overlapping scene border fill (nodata=0) or -9999 drags the mean/stddev toward the sentinel for every band.`
- **RSALGO-14**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:image_fusion / fusion aliases (rs_fusion_aliases.cpp:108) -> processNativeFusion('gram_schmidt')`
  - *Code context*: `Streaming pass 1: `normSq[0] += synVal*synVal; coef[k][0] += msBuf[b][i]*synVal;` then `coef[b+1][0] /= normSq[0]` - a through-origin slope sum(ms*syn)/sum(syn^2). The in-memory gramSchmidtFusion computes the centered coefficient with the explicit justification at 558-563: 'A through-origin dot product is dominated by the bands' mean offsets (DN imagery has large means), which leaves nearly all of band k's offset in the residual and degrades spectral fidelity'. On DN-scale data the through-origin slope ~= mean_ms/mean_syn (~1) instead of Cov/Var, applying the full pan detail to weakly-correlated bands.`
- **RSALGO-15**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:image_fusion / fusion aliases -> processNativeFusion`
  - *Code context*: ``const int nMsBands = std::min( msBands, 4 );` with no warning or parameter - an 8-band (e.g. WorldView/SuperDove) or 224-band MS input yields a 4-band fused product and bands 5+ are silently dropped (non-IHS methods promise 'fused bands (same count as msBands)' in the header docs). readMsWindow resamples differing-resolution MS onto the pan grid via readBandWindowScaled -> GDALRasterIO default GRA_NearestNeighbour (gdal_dataset_wrapper.cpp:304-307), so each 20m MS pixel is block-replicated 2x2 on a 10m pan grid before fusion - standard practice is bilinear/cubic for the MS upsample.`
- **RSALGO-16**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `stddevStretch/histogramEqualize (image_enhancement.cpp:75, 92) -> MathUtils::computeStatsWithNodata; ChangeDetection::statistics -> operator change reports`
  - *Code context*: `Validity predicate is `std::isnan(data[i])` only (find-first-valid loop :33, accumulation :55, stddev pass :69). A single +inf (saturated sensor value, overflow from an upstream division, Float32 max fill) makes max=inf, mean=inf, stddev=inf. Consumers: ChangeDetection::statistics (change_detection.cpp:75), ImageEnhancement::stddevStretch (means lo/hi=inf -> whole band collapses) and histogramEqualize (min/max=inf -> binWidth=inf -> all values bin 0), AtmosphericCorrection DarkObjectStats correctly uses isfinite (atmospheric_correction.cpp:93) showing the intended convention.`
- **RSALGO-17**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `contrast stretch presets (post-#183 mapping) / image enhancement panel -> ImageEnhancement::histogramEqualize`
  - *Code context*: ``cdf[0] = hist[0]/validCount; cdf[i] = cdf[i-1] + hist[i]/validCount; ... output[i] = cdf[bin]*255.0f;` - the raw CDF is mapped straight to 0-255. The standard equalization (Gonzalez-Woods; OpenCV equalizeHist) remaps via (cdf(v) - cdf_min)/(N - cdf_min)*(L-1) so the darkest populated value maps to 0. With hist[0]/N = h0, the darkest pixels output h0*255 (e.g. 5% dark clip -> floor at ~13) and the effective range shrinks to (1-h0)*255.`
- **RSALGO-18**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs:change_detection thresholdMethod=otsu (and the streaming histogram variant) -> otsuThresholdFromHistogram`
  - *Code context*: `Histogram fill: `int bin = static_cast<int>((v - minVal) / range * (bins - 1));` (bin width = range/(bins-1), maxVal lands in bin bins-1) but the threshold is placed at `minVal + (bestBin + 0.5) * range / bins` (bin width = range/bins). The reconstruction grid does not match the accumulation grid; for bestBin=b the returned level is min + (b+0.5)*range/bins while the true bin center is min + (b+0.5)*range/(bins-1) - off by (b+0.5)*range*(1/bins - 1/(bins-1)), up to ~0.4% of range at b=255 (bins=256). percentileThresholdFromHistogram (217-253) consistently uses range/bins, so Otsu and percentile thresholds computed from the same histogram are on different grids.`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: Numerics members verified. RSALGO-12: chunked_processor.cpp:50,60-81 writes QVector<bool> results[idx] (bit-packed) from multiple QtConcurrent::blockingMap threads with no synchronization — distinct indices in the same 32-bit word race on load-modify-store (UB); currently benign only because the sole callers (ImageEnhancement speckle filters) always return true — latent. RSALGO-16: math_utils.cpp computeStats validity predicate is std::isnan only (:33,:55,:69) — +inf/-inf pass, poisoning min/max/mean/stddev for every consumer. RSALGO-18: change_detection.cpp histograms with (bins-1) spacing but thresholds with /bins — verified from code quote.
- **Review note**: RSALGO-12 must be labeled latent (no live wrong behavior today); P3 for all.
- **Finding RSALGO-9**: `hasNodata checks are `a == nodata || b == nodata || ...` with no std::isnan on neighbors (the center pixel does get `std::isnan(z)` at :55/:83). tri/tpi/roughness DO check `v == nodata || std::isnan(v)` (:332, :383, :434). The operator passes nodata=-9999 whenever the band NoData is NaN (`if (hasNodata && std::isfinite(dsNodata))`, rs_terrain_analysis_operator.cpp:119) so float DEMs with NaN NoData produce NaN results through the Horn sum instead of the intended neighbor-fallback, and the output mixes NaN pixels with -9999 pixels.`
- **Finding RSALGO-10**: ``const std::array<double,6> gt = ds.geoTransform(); if (std::abs(gt[1]) > 1e-7) cellSize = static_cast<float>(std::abs(gt[1]));` - gt[5] (Y resolution) never consulted; the kernels accept one scalar used for both dzdx and dzdy (terrain_analysis.cpp:47-49). Horn slope magnitude = atan(sqrt((dz/dx)^2+(dz/dy)^2)); with cellSizeX != |gt[5]| the steeper-axis gradient is scaled by the wrong factor (e.g. 1m x 2m pixels -> dzdy halves -> slope underestimated up to ~2x, aspect rotated toward the X axis).`
- **Finding RSALGO-12**: ``QVector<bool> results(m_chunks.size());` then inside QtConcurrent::blockingMap lambda `results[idx] = callback(...)` from multiple pool threads. QVector<bool> packs 32+ booleans per word; distinct indices in the same word race on load-modify-store (not std::vector<bool> style atomicity, no synchronization). The check loop `for (bool r : results) if (!r) return false;` may observe lost updates. Currently latent: the only users (ImageEnhancement speckle filters, image_enhancement.cpp:667/729/806/885/956) always `return true` and ignore process()'s return value, so no functional impact today.`
- **Finding RSALGO-13**: `Per-band accumulation filters only `if (!std::isfinite(value)) continue;` - the band's declared NoData sentinel (read via GDALGetRasterNoDataValue is never done here) is included in sum/sumSq/validCount. An ROI overlapping scene border fill (nodata=0) or -9999 drags the mean/stddev toward the sentinel for every band.`
- **Finding RSALGO-14**: `Streaming pass 1: `normSq[0] += synVal*synVal; coef[k][0] += msBuf[b][i]*synVal;` then `coef[b+1][0] /= normSq[0]` - a through-origin slope sum(ms*syn)/sum(syn^2). The in-memory gramSchmidtFusion computes the centered coefficient with the explicit justification at 558-563: 'A through-origin dot product is dominated by the bands' mean offsets (DN imagery has large means), which leaves nearly all of band k's offset in the residual and degrades spectral fidelity'. On DN-scale data the through-origin slope ~= mean_ms/mean_syn (~1) instead of Cov/Var, applying the full pan detail to weakly-correlated bands.`
- **Finding RSALGO-15**: ``const int nMsBands = std::min( msBands, 4 );` with no warning or parameter - an 8-band (e.g. WorldView/SuperDove) or 224-band MS input yields a 4-band fused product and bands 5+ are silently dropped (non-IHS methods promise 'fused bands (same count as msBands)' in the header docs). readMsWindow resamples differing-resolution MS onto the pan grid via readBandWindowScaled -> GDALRasterIO default GRA_NearestNeighbour (gdal_dataset_wrapper.cpp:304-307), so each 20m MS pixel is block-replicated 2x2 on a 10m pan grid before fusion - standard practice is bilinear/cubic for the MS upsample.`
- **Finding RSALGO-16**: `Validity predicate is `std::isnan(data[i])` only (find-first-valid loop :33, accumulation :55, stddev pass :69). A single +inf (saturated sensor value, overflow from an upstream division, Float32 max fill) makes max=inf, mean=inf, stddev=inf. Consumers: ChangeDetection::statistics (change_detection.cpp:75), ImageEnhancement::stddevStretch (means lo/hi=inf -> whole band collapses) and histogramEqualize (min/max=inf -> binWidth=inf -> all values bin 0), AtmosphericCorrection DarkObjectStats correctly uses isfinite (atmospheric_correction.cpp:93) showing the intended convention.`
- **Finding RSALGO-17**: ``cdf[0] = hist[0]/validCount; cdf[i] = cdf[i-1] + hist[i]/validCount; ... output[i] = cdf[bin]*255.0f;` - the raw CDF is mapped straight to 0-255. The standard equalization (Gonzalez-Woods; OpenCV equalizeHist) remaps via (cdf(v) - cdf_min)/(N - cdf_min)*(L-1) so the darkest populated value maps to 0. With hist[0]/N = h0, the darkest pixels output h0*255 (e.g. 5% dark clip -> floor at ~13) and the effective range shrinks to (1-h0)*255.`
- **Finding RSALGO-18**: `Histogram fill: `int bin = static_cast<int>((v - minVal) / range * (bins - 1));` (bin width = range/(bins-1), maxVal lands in bin bins-1) but the threshold is placed at `minVal + (bestBin + 0.5) * range / bins` (bin width = range/bins). The reconstruction grid does not match the accumulation grid; for bestBin=b the returned level is min + (b+0.5)*range/bins while the true bin center is min + (b+0.5)*range/(bins-1) - off by (b+0.5)*range*(1/bins - 1/(bins-1)), up to ~0.4% of range at b=255 (bins=256). percentileThresholdFromHistogram (217-253) consistently uses range/bins, so Otsu and percentile thresholds computed from the same histogram are on different grids.`

## Suggested fix
- Correct the mathematical formulas, coordinate system transforms, and NoData boundary conditions to align with standard GIS conventions (Horn 1981, GDAL, IEEE-754).

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (RSALGO-9, RSALGO-10, RSALGO-12, RSALGO-13, RSALGO-14, RSALGO-15, RSALGO-16, RSALGO-17, RSALGO-18).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- RSALGO-16 #193/#190 are spatial-filter NoData modules, not stats; no prior math_utils inf issue.
- Finding RSALGO-9: #203 covered cellSize only; no issue covers neighbor NaN handling in these kernels.
- Finding RSALGO-10: #203 (commit 763966246f) fixed the hard 30.0 default; anisotropy remains at HEAD.
- Finding RSALGO-12: #229 (ddc029502c) made completedChunks atomic - the results array race was not addressed.
- Finding RSALGO-13: #230 fixed segment_stats and mosaic-Y in operators; the ROI profile kernel was not covered. #256 fixed its per-pixel I/O only.
- Finding RSALGO-14: No closed issue covers GS fusion numerics (7a822b2f40 was grid preflight/PCA NaN).
- Finding RSALGO-15: No closed issue; #182 was dialog band combos.
- Finding RSALGO-16: #175 fixed PPI NaN guards; #287 JM covariance underflow. No issue covers computeStats inf handling.
- Finding RSALGO-17: #224 mentions 'histogram-equalize edge cases' tests as never-compiled (test files unused) - the formula itself was never reported.
- Finding RSALGO-18: 519e8b7872 added the statistical/MMU methods; no closed issue covers Otsu bin math.

body:
## Summary
OTB/native provider minors batch 2: auto-discovery -in/-out skeleton; blocking QMessageBox in headless load; bilateral mislabel; extension-append existence check; merged-channel stderr; hardcoded ':' PATH; distance-matrix output type ignored; symdiff/intersection attribute loss; extract-by-attribute string compares. This issue aggregates 9 related finding(s): PROVO-6, PROVO-7, PROVO-8, PROVO-9, PROVO-10, PROVO-11, PROVO-12, PROVO-13, PROVO-14. Specifically, Auto-discovered OTB applications are registered with a fixed '-in {INPUT} -out {OUTPUT}' argument skeleton most OTB apps do not accept - discovered tools mostly cannot run and EXTRA cannot remove the invented keys. Specifically, GenericCliProvider::loadToolsFromDirectory pops a blocking QMessageBox for malformed tool JSON during provider loading - headless/worker startup can hang forever. Specifically, Shipped custom OTB JSON tools mislabeled: otb_bilateral_filter.json runs a Gaussian smoothing while advertising bilateral/edge-preserving behavior - #240's label/behavior cleanup stopped at the median file.

## Area
Processing Framework / GDAL & OTB Providers

## Type
processing/provider

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/processing/providers/otb_tools/provider.cpp:100-105 (registration); src/processing/tools/cli_tool_discovery.cpp:329-354 (config builder)` (OtbToolsProvider::loadAlgorithms / CliToolDiscovery::makeOtbDiscoveredConfig)
- `src/processing/providers/generic_cli/provider.cpp:69-81` (GenericCliProvider::loadToolsFromDirectory)
- `data/tools/custom/otb_bilateral_filter.json:2-16,44-46 (id/name/command/args/help); data/tools/custom/otb_median_filter.json (filename vs mean content)` (JSON tool definition vs otbcli_Smoothing behavior)
- `src/processing/providers/otb_tools/otb_tool_wrapper.cpp:109-133` (OtbToolWrapper::processAlgorithm (result collection))
- `src/processing/providers/otb_tools/algorithms/otb_pixel_info.cpp:50-77; otb_read_image_info.cpp:44-71` (OtbPixelInfoAlgorithm::processAlgorithm / OtbReadImageInfoAlgorithm::processAlgorithm)
- `src/processing/providers/otb_tools/otb_tool_wrapper.cpp:178-179; src/processing/providers/generic_cli/generic_cli_algorithm.cpp:361-362` (OtbToolWrapper::runOtbApplication / GenericCliAlgorithm::processAlgorithm)
- `src/processing/providers/qgis_algorithms/algorithms/vector/vector_distance_matrix.cpp:39-48, 100-109, 188-190` (VectorDistanceMatrixAlgorithm::initAlgorithm/processAlgorithm)
- `src/processing/providers/qgis_algorithms/algorithms/vector/vector_symmetrical_difference.cpp:119-126; native_intersection.h:56-58,92-98` (VectorSymmetricalDifferenceAlgorithm::processAlgorithm / QgsIntersectionAlgorithm::processAlgorithm)
- `src/processing/providers/qgis_algorithms/algorithms/native/native_extract_by_attribute.h:41-43,76-77` (QgsExtractByAttributeAlgorithm::processAlgorithm)

## User impact
- catalog promises tools that always error; noisy UX, duplicated surface with the 13 already-broken handcrafted wrappers
- app/worker startup hang from a bad user config file
- user-selected filtering semantics silently wrong; same drift class #240 closed against, incompletely swept
- false failures and lost outputs on a legal user input; TEMPORARY_OUTPUT is unaffected (extension generated by QGIS)
- degraded diagnostics and env divergence in exactly the failure path users need to read
- OTB toolchain unusable on Windows packaged builds
- user-visible schema drift; downstream consumers asking for the matrix shape get the wrong layout
- output layers lose the attribute data users expect from equivalently-named QGIS algorithms
- empty or wrong selections for numeric fields despite the QGIS-native naming

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (PROVO-6)**: open any auto-discovered OTB tool (everything not in the 30 handcrafted apps) in a build with the OTB bundle present and run it
- **Trigger (PROVO-7)**: user drops a syntactically invalid .json into the custom tools dir, then starts the app or headless/MCP worker
- **Trigger (PROVO-8)**: run the shipped 'OTB 双边滤波' (bilateral) tool
- **Trigger (PROVO-9)**: user types an output path without extension in the raster/vector destination widget of any OTB tool
- **Trigger (PROVO-10)**: any failing otbcli_PixelValue/ReadImageInfo invocation (e.g. invalid coordinates or unreadable raster)
- **Trigger (PROVO-11)**: any OTB or generic otbcli_* tool on a Windows build with a bundled OTB
- **Trigger (PROVO-12)**: choose 'Standard (N x K x M)' style matrix output
- **Trigger (PROVO-13)**: run Symmetrical Difference (any input) or Intersection (any input) and inspect the attribute table
- **Trigger (PROVO-14)**: filter a numeric (int/float/bool) field or use any non-equality operator expectation

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (PROVO-6)**: discovered tools either expose generic passthrough args or declare that only -in/-out-style apps are usable
- **Expected (PROVO-7)**: log the error (QgsMessageLog/SICNU_LOG) and skip, as the rest of the processing stack does
- **Expected (PROVO-8)**: label/id describe the actual behavior (Gaussian) or the tool is removed/renamed
- **Expected (PROVO-9)**: fall back to checking/returning path+'.tif'/'.shp' (or normalize the destination before running)
- **Expected (PROVO-10)**: error text includes the OTB stderr/stdout tail and env parity with the shared runner
- **Expected (PROVO-11)**: QDir::listSeparator() (or platform branch)
- **Expected (PROVO-12)**: wide/standard matrix format as advertised (QGIS DistanceMatrix semantics)
- **Expected (PROVO-13)**: attributes preserved/carried through per QGIS-native semantics
- **Expected (PROVO-14)**: typed comparison with operator selection (parameterAsEnum of operators, numeric compare via QVariant::toDouble)

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (PROVO-6)**: ~70 toolbox entries that structurally cannot execute for apps with different key names
- **Actual (PROVO-7)**: startup blocks on a modal dialog with no parent; in offscreen/headless platforms there is no one to dismiss it
- **Actual (PROVO-8)**: Gaussian smoothing delivered under a bilateral contract
- **Actual (PROVO-9)**: 'Tool reported success but output file is missing: <path>' exception and no output registered
- **Actual (PROVO-10)**: 'OTB application failed with exit code 1: ' - empty cause; user cannot diagnose
- **Actual (PROVO-11)**: PATH corrupted; OTB subprocess launch fails
- **Actual (PROVO-12)**: linear pair list without rank
- **Actual (PROVO-13)**: symdiff: all attributes empty; intersection: overlay columns absent
- **Actual (PROVO-14)**: string equality only; numeric formats and operators unsupported; NULL=='' edge match

## Root cause
- **PROVO-6**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `OtbToolsProvider::loadAlgorithms -> discoverOtbApplicationNames -> GenericCliAlgorithm(config) -> processAlgorithm -> buildArgs emits '-in <path> -out <path>' -> otbcli rejects`
  - *Code context*: `makeOtbDiscoveredConfig always inserts args ["-in","{INPUT}","-out","{OUTPUT}"] plus INPUT/OUTPUT parameter definitions, and OtbToolsProvider::loadAlgorithms registers every discovered otbcli_* binary this way. Most OTB applications do not use the '-in'/'-out' keys (e.g. TrainImagesClassifier uses io.il/io.out, BundleToPerfectSensor inp/inxs, ComputeImagesStatistics il/out.xml, BandMath il), so OTB's parser fails with 'Cannot find parameter -in'; buildArgs (generic_cli_algorithm.cpp:209-243) emits the template unconditionally and 'append_extra' EXTRA can only append arguments, never remove the invalid ones.`
- **PROVO-7**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `registry->addProvider(new GenericCliProvider) -> loadAlgorithms -> loadToolsFromDirectory(user dir) -> malformed user JSON -> QMessageBox::warning exec modal loop`
  - *Code context*: `'QMessageBox::warning(nullptr, QObject::tr("Tool Configuration Error"), ...)' on QJsonParseError and on missing 'id' - executed from loadAlgorithms(), which QgsProcessingRegistry calls during provider registration. In MCP/headless mode (no interactive user; parent nullptr) a modal static QMessageBox blocks the event loop indefinitely. Only user-writable ~/.sicnu_geo_rs/tools entries trigger it, but the same provider is constructed in headless executables.`
- **PROVO-8**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `GenericCliProvider::loadToolsFromDirectory -> otb_bilateral_filter tool in toolbox -> user picks 'bilateral' expecting edge preservation -> Gaussian smoothing destroys edges`
  - *Code context*: `otb_bilateral_filter.json: id 'otb_bilateral_filter', short_description/description 'OTB 双边滤波', help '边缘保持的平滑滤波' (edge-preserving smoothing = bilateral), tags ['bilateral'... via 'filter'] but args pass '-type gaussian -type.gaussian.stdev {SPATIAL}' to otbcli_Smoothing - a plain Gaussian blur, which is NOT edge-preserving; OTB Smoothing has no bilateral mode at all. Separately otb_median_filter.json still ships a mean filter (id otb_mean_filter); after #240 the id/name/args are self-consistent but the filename remains 'median' and no median tool exists.`
- **PROVO-9**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `OtbToolWrapper::processAlgorithm -> runOtbApplication succeeds (OTB wrote <path>.tif) -> QFileInfo::exists(<path>) false -> exception`
  - *Code context*: `'const QString outPath = resolvedParameters.value(param->name()).toString(); if (!outPath.isEmpty() && !QFileInfo::exists(outPath)) { ... "Tool reported success but output file is missing" ... throw QgsProcessingException(err); }' - OTB output parameters append a default extension (.tif for images, .shp for vectors) when the user-typed destination has none (the reason QGIS's own OTB provider post-executes a search for outputFile+'.tif'/'.shp'). The wrapper checks the literal typed path only, and inserts that same path into results, so a valid run with '/tmp/out' (OTB writes '/tmp/out.tif') is reported as failure and downstream consumers receive a nonexistent path.`
- **PROVO-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `otb_pixel_info run -> private QProcess loop -> nonzero exit -> readAllStandardError()==empty -> reportError without cause`
  - *Code context*: `'proc.setProcessChannelMode(QProcess::MergedChannels);' then on failure '.arg(QString::fromUtf8(proc.readAllStandardError()))' - with MergedChannels readAllStandardError() is always empty, so the message is 'failed with exit code N: ' with no diagnostic (the shared runOtbApplication in otb_tool_wrapper.cpp:208-211 correctly reads readAllStandardOutput). Both also skip the OTB_APPLICATION_PATH/PATH/LC_NUMERIC environment setup that runOtbApplication performs (otb_tool_wrapper.cpp:172-182), relying on otbcli self-location. Additionally feedback is dereferenced without a null check (lines 41,48 vs the shared runner's 'if (feedback)').`
- **PROVO-11**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `runOtbApplication -> QProcessEnvironment PATH rebuild with ':' -> proc.start on Windows -> launcher not found / dependency load failure`
  - *Code context*: `'const QString path = env.value(QStringLiteral("PATH")); env.insert(QStringLiteral("PATH"), binPath + (path.isEmpty() ? QString() : QStringLiteral(":") + path));' - on Windows the list separator is ';', so PATH becomes one invalid entry and otbcli plus its dependencies are not found from the bundle. The codebase otherwise targets Windows too (vcpkg manifest, QStandardPaths::findExecutable cross-platform comment in tool_path_manager.cpp:176-181). LD_LIBRARY_PATH handling in generic_cli_algorithm.cpp:363-365 is likewise Unix-only but harmless elsewhere.`
- **PROVO-12**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `qgis_algorithms:vector_distance_matrix with OUTPUT_TYPE=1 -> per-target rows appended linearly`
  - *Code context*: `Enum offers 'Linear (N * K x 4)' and 'Standard (N x M)' (lines 39-43); output fields are always InputID/TargetID/Distance(+Rank) (lines 101-109 with comment 'Linear output: always produces linear format'); in the writing loop 'if (outputType == 0) outputFeat.setAttribute("Rank", rank)' is the only place outputType is consulted (line 188). Selecting Standard yields the same linear table minus Rank - never an N x M matrix.`
- **PROVO-13**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `overlay run -> one combined symDiff geometry or per-intersection features written with unpopulated/missing attribute columns`
  - *Code context*: `vector_symmetrical_difference.cpp: sink is created with source->fields() (line 41) but the single emitted feature is default-constructed: 'QgsFeature outputFeat; outputFeat.setFields(source->fields()); outputFeat.setGeometry(symDiff);' - no setAttribute calls, so every record has empty attributes for the whole layer. native_intersection.h:57-58 creates the sink with 'source->fields()' only; makeIntersectionFeature copies input attributes only - QGIS native 'Intersection' concatenates overlay attributes (the shipped native_union.h:56-67 does build combined fields, showing the intended pattern).`
- **PROVO-14**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `qgis_algorithms:extractbyattribute -> per-feature string equality on attribute(fieldIdx)`
  - *Code context*: `'if (feat.attribute(fieldIdx).toString() == value) sink->addFeature(...)' - VALUE is a plain string, no OPERATOR parameter is defined (QGIS native extractbyattribute exposes =,!=,>,>=,<,<=,begins with, contains, is null/is not null). QVariant::toString() on numeric fields makes 5.0 vs typed '5.0'/'5' mismatches, doubles render with Qt formatting, and NULL attributes toString()=='' match an empty VALUE.`

## Suggested fix
- Align parameter definitions, argument builders, and result harvesting with the QGIS/GDAL/OTB provider execution contract.

## Summary
gdal provider minors batch 2: dead global error handler; exact-WKT CRS equality false positives; gdal:warp missing -overwrite; rasterize rotation/gdal_edit/extent conventions. This issue aggregates 3 related finding(s): PROVG-9, PROVG-10, PROVG-11. Specifically, raster_grid_compat compares CRS by exact WKT string — semantically identical CRS in different WKT dialects (ESRI vs OGC, WKT1 vs WKT2) is blocked as CrsMismatch. Specifically, gdal:warp never passes -overwrite — re-running to an existing OUTPUT hard-errors with a cryptic GDAL message (or silently merges into the old file when no creation options are set). Specifically, gdal_tools argument-construction minors: rasterize template ignores rotation, gdal_edit half-set -tr silently dropped, extent-string conventions contradict across tools, .py-only toolNames with no fallback, FORMAT enum vs default .tif extension, gdaltransform OUTPUT never resolved.

## Area
Processing Framework / GDAL & OTB Providers

## Type
processing/provider

## Severity
P3

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/data/raster_grid_compat.cpp (fed by src/processing/gdal/gdal_grid_compat.cpp):118-143` (compareGrids / gridFromDataset)
- `src/processing/providers/gdal_tools/algorithms/gdal_warp.cpp:19-44` (GdalWarpAlgorithm::buildArgs)
- `src/processing/providers/gdal_tools/algorithms/:gdal_rasterize.cpp:61-71; gdal_edit.cpp:61-67; gdal_warp.cpp:29-34 + gdal_grid.cpp:72-80 vs ogr2ogr.cpp:24-26,96-101; gdal_calc.h:20 + tool_path_manager.cpp:18-40; gdal_translate.cpp:12-13,27-30 + gdalbuildvrt.cpp:22-23; gdaltransform.cpp:147-157` (GdalRasterizeAlgorithm::buildArgs; GdalEditAlgorithm::buildArgs; toolName()/ToolPathManager::gdalToolPath; GdalTransformAlgorithm::processAlgorithm)

## User impact
- False blocking of legitimate operations; user must reproject a raster that is already in the right CRS (safe-direction failure, but a real usability/correctness gap in the #191-fixed service)
- Reruns fail confusingly at best; at worst produce a mosaic of two runs' pixels without any warning
- Individually small; collectively wrong-or-confusing CLI behavior in the gdal tool layer that the #169/#228 fix batches did not reach

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (PROVG-9)**: Pair rasters whose CRSs are the same projection but stored as different WKT flavors (very common when mixing ESRI-produced and GDAL-produced files)
- **Trigger (PROVG-10)**: Run gdal:warp twice to the same explicit OUTPUT path (user-specified file or repeated batch target), with TARGET_CRS/EXTENT set
- **Trigger (PROVG-11)**: (a) rotated raster template; (b) only X_RES filled; (c) one extent string reused across warp and ogr2ogr; (d) deployment with C++-only GDAL utilities; (e) non-GTiff FORMAT selected; (f) new output folder in gdal:transform

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (PROVG-9)**: Semantic CRS equality (e.g. QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem comparison via OSRIsSame/authority codes) — mismatch only for genuinely different CRSs
- **Expected (PROVG-10)**: -overwrite emitted (matching QGIS behavior) so reruns replace the output
- **Expected (PROVG-11)**: Rotation-aware -te; validation error or single-axis -tr; one canonical extent order across tools (or format-aware parsing); .py/name fallback in resolution; extension matching the chosen format; resolved destination in gdaltransform

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (PROVG-9)**: False-positive blocking 'grid.crs_mismatch' forcing unnecessary reprojection; multi-layer ops refuse to run
- **Actual (PROVG-10)**: Hard failure with GDAL's 'delete existing dataset' error, or — with no creation options — silent blending of old and new coverage
- **Actual (PROVG-11)**: As listed per sub-item — all silent except (d)/(f) which fail with generic errors

## Root cause
- **PROVG-9**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `rs change-detection / post-classification compare / fusion dialogs -> gridFromDataset + compareGrids -> blocking grid.crs_mismatch`
  - *Code context*: ``if ( aHasCrs && bHasCrs && a.crsWkt != b.crsWkt )` -> blocking CrsMismatch. gridFromDataset stores ds.projection() raw (GDALGetProjectionRef), which returns whatever WKT dialect the producer wrote (ESRI .aux/.prj vs OGC GeoTIFF key encoding vs WKT2); identical projections expressed differently never compare equal as strings. All consumers (change detection rs_change_primitives.cpp:80, rs_change_detection_operator.cpp:265, rs_post_classification_change_operator.cpp:155, image_fusion.cpp:712, dialog_utils.cpp:148) block on this verdict.`
- **PROVG-10**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Toolbox dialog / pipeline rerun -> TaskCenter -> ProviderAlgorithmAdapter::execute -> GdalToolWrapper::processAlgorithm -> GdalWarpAlgorithm::buildArgs -> gdalwarp subprocess`
  - *Code context*: `buildArgs emits only -t_srs/-te/EXTRA + INPUT/OUTPUT — no -overwrite. Empirically verified on GDAL 3.13.2: second `gdalwarp -te ... src dst` with existing dst -> 'ERROR 1: Output dataset ... exists, but some command line options were provided indicating a new dataset should be created. Please delete existing dataset and run again.' (exit != 0). Without -te/-t_srs/-tr, gdalwarp instead warps INTO the existing dataset (append/blend semantics) — stale pixels survive wherever the new coverage does not overwrite. QGIS's own gdalwarp wrapper always passes -overwrite. Other wrappers (gdal_translate & co.) truncate via GDALCreate, so only warp is affected.`
- **PROVG-11**: confirmed
  - *Callchain*: `Toolbox dialogs / pipelines -> TaskCenter -> ProviderAlgorithmAdapter::execute -> GdalToolWrapper::processAlgorithm -> buildArgs -> external tools`
  - *Code context*: `(a) rasterize template path derives -te from only gt[0],gt[3],gt[1],gt[5] — gt[2]/gt[4] rotation/shear ignored (same class as #189 VRT fix; rotated template -> wrong burn extent); (b) gdal_edit emits -tr only when BOTH X_RES and Y_RES are set — a lone X_RES is silently ignored, no validation error; (c) warp/grid/rasterize parse EXTENT as 'xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax' while ogr2ogr documents and parses SPAT as 'xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax' — one 4-number string silently yields a transposed box in the other tool (split(',').size()==4 passes either way); (d) toolName() hardcodes .py names (gdal_calc.py, gdal_merge.py, gdal_edit.py, gdal_retile.py, pct2rgb.py, rgb2pct.py, gdal2xyz.py) and gdalToolPath has no basename fallback — works on distros shipping both (Arch GDAL 3.13) but fails 'GDAL tool not found' on GDAL builds without Python scripts (e.g. vcpkg Windows); (e) gdal_translate/pct2rgb/rgb2pct FORMAT enums include PNG/JPEG/AAIGrid while OUTPUT is a RasterDestination defaulting to a .tif name (gdalbuildvrt likewise writes VRT content into output.tif) — extension lies about format for external tools; (f) gdaltransform's processAlgorithm override skips resolveDestinationParameters, writing to the raw OUTPUT string (QFileInfo parent-dir creation that parameterAsOutputLayer performs never happens -> 'Failed to write output file' when the folder is new).`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: PROVG-8 DROPPED: GdalErrorHandler is referenced by no source outside its own .cpp/.h (verified: zero instantiations) — dead code, so the process-global-vs-thread_local install/uninstall corruption cannot currently fire; latent-only. PROVG-9 verified: raster_grid_compat.cpp:118-143 blocks with CrsMismatch when `a.crsWkt != b.crsWkt` exact string inequality — no WKT dialect normalization, and gridFromDataset stores the raw GDALGetProjectionRef string. PROVG-10/11 accepted from evidence (gdal:warp missing -overwrite; rasterize rotation/extent conventions).
- **Review note**: Drop PROVG-8 as latent/dead before filing; remaining three stand.
- **Finding PROVG-9**: ``if ( aHasCrs && bHasCrs && a.crsWkt != b.crsWkt )` -> blocking CrsMismatch. gridFromDataset stores ds.projection() raw (GDALGetProjectionRef), which returns whatever WKT dialect the producer wrote (ESRI .aux/.prj vs OGC GeoTIFF key encoding vs WKT2); identical projections expressed differently never compare equal as strings. All consumers (change detection rs_change_primitives.cpp:80, rs_change_detection_operator.cpp:265, rs_post_classification_change_operator.cpp:155, image_fusion.cpp:712, dialog_utils.cpp:148) block on this verdict.`
- **Finding PROVG-10**: `buildArgs emits only -t_srs/-te/EXTRA + INPUT/OUTPUT — no -overwrite. Empirically verified on GDAL 3.13.2: second `gdalwarp -te ... src dst` with existing dst -> 'ERROR 1: Output dataset ... exists, but some command line options were provided indicating a new dataset should be created. Please delete existing dataset and run again.' (exit != 0). Without -te/-t_srs/-tr, gdalwarp instead warps INTO the existing dataset (append/blend semantics) — stale pixels survive wherever the new coverage does not overwrite. QGIS's own gdalwarp wrapper always passes -overwrite. Other wrappers (gdal_translate & co.) truncate via GDALCreate, so only warp is affected.`
- **Finding PROVG-11**: `(a) rasterize template path derives -te from only gt[0],gt[3],gt[1],gt[5] — gt[2]/gt[4] rotation/shear ignored (same class as #189 VRT fix; rotated template -> wrong burn extent); (b) gdal_edit emits -tr only when BOTH X_RES and Y_RES are set — a lone X_RES is silently ignored, no validation error; (c) warp/grid/rasterize parse EXTENT as 'xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax' while ogr2ogr documents and parses SPAT as 'xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax' — one 4-number string silently yields a transposed box in the other tool (split(',').size()==4 passes either way); (d) toolName() hardcodes .py names (gdal_calc.py, gdal_merge.py, gdal_edit.py, gdal_retile.py, pct2rgb.py, rgb2pct.py, gdal2xyz.py) and gdalToolPath has no basename fallback — works on distros shipping both (Arch GDAL 3.13) but fails 'GDAL tool not found' on GDAL builds without Python scripts (e.g. vcpkg Windows); (e) gdal_translate/pct2rgb/rgb2pct FORMAT enums include PNG/JPEG/AAIGrid while OUTPUT is a RasterDestination defaulting to a .tif name (gdalbuildvrt likewise writes VRT content into output.tif) — extension lies about format for external tools; (f) gdaltransform's processAlgorithm override skips resolveDestinationParameters, writing to the raw OUTPUT string (QFileInfo parent-dir creation that parameterAsOutputLayer performs never happens -> 'Failed to write output file' when the folder is new).`

## Suggested fix
- Align parameter definitions, argument builders, and result harvesting with the QGIS/GDAL/OTB provider execution contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (PROVG-9, PROVG-10, PROVG-11).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- No prior issues for these provider minors; #231/#241 are schema/runtime path items.
- Finding PROVG-9: #191 addressed over-permissive mirrored acceptance; the over-strict string-CRS comparison is the unreported opposite direction. Verified at HEAD.
- Finding PROVG-10: #169/#228/#230 did not touch gdal_warp.cpp overwrite behavior (git log: last substantive change 8cc594609a). Verified at HEAD.
- Finding PROVG-11: #169 (commit 8cc594609a) fixed -of enum index/-ts/-te order/-outsize; #228 fixed contour interval, gdalmanage NEWNAME, gdaltransform failure path; none of sub-items (a)-(f). #189 fixed VRT SrcRect rotation only. Verified all at HEAD.
