body:
## Summary
Empty weak-stub constructors of trimmed QGIS widgets are reachable from compiled UI paths - constructing them is UB/crash (Expression Builder/LineEdit, graduated histogram, curve editor, rich text editor, JSON editor). This issue aggregates 8 related finding(s): UIF-1, UIF-2, UIF-3, UIF-4, UIF-5, VPATCH-1, VPATCH-2, UIF-8. Specifically, Expression Builder dialogs embed QgsExpressionBuilderWidget whose constructor links to an empty weak stub - opening any expression editor constructs an uninitialized QObject (UB/crash). Specifically, QgsExpressionLineEdit embedded in 6 live forms (incl. the Processing feature-source options page) links to the empty weak-stub constructor - constructing those pages is UB/crash. Specifically, Graduated renderer form embeds QgsGraduatedHistogramWidget whose ctor is an empty weak stub - selecting the Graduated renderer crashes the Symbology tab.

## Area
GUI / Application Shell / Dialogs

## Type
ui/interaction

## Severity
P1

## Baseline
- Repository: WindWang2/exp-rs
- Branch: master
- Commit: d9c59e5b8290a74cbfe6c8c9f3c7209c6cdab7dc

## Affected code
- `src/ui/qgsexpressionbuilderdialogbase.ui:21-28,42-49 (also src/ui/qgsexpressionselectiondialogbase.ui:83, src/ui/qgsfieldcalculatorbase.ui:188-196)` (QgsExpressionBuilderWidget 'builder' / 'mExpressionBuilder')
- `src/ui/processing/qgsprocessingfeaturesourceoptionsbase.ui:95 (plus src/ui/symbollayer/qgsgeometrygeneratorwidgetbase.ui:18, src/ui/qgsdbimportvectorlayerdialog.ui:292, src/ui/attributeformconfig/qgsattributetypeedit.ui:213, src/ui/numericformats/qgsexpressionbasednumericformatwidgetbase.ui:30, src/ui/processing/qgsprocessingvectortilewriterlayerdetailswidgetbase.ui:72)` (mFilterExpressionWidget / modificationExpressionSelector / mExpressionWidget / mExpressionSelector / mEditFilterExpression)
- `src/ui/qgsgraduatedsymbolrendererwidget.ui:496-500,545-549` (mHistogramWidget)
- `src/ui/qgspropertyassistantwidgetbase.ui:197-201` (mCurveEditor)
- `src/ui/annotations/qgsannotationlinetextwidgetbase.ui:72 (also src/ui/annotations/qgsannotationpointtextwidgetbase.ui:132, src/ui/annotations/qgsannotationrectangulartextwidgetbase.ui:226, src/ui/processing/qgsprocessinghelpeditorwidgetbase.ui:137)` (mTextEdit / mRichTextEdit)
- `src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1912-1987 (trim) + src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:344-345,527-529 (stubs)` (QgsExpressionLineEdit::QgsExpressionLineEdit / QgsExpressionBuilderWidget::QgsExpressionBuilderWidget)
- `src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:743-781 (JsonEditWidget), 1271-1293 (SensorThingsSubsetEditor), 791-873 (LayoutHtmlWidget)` (QgsJsonEditWidget::QgsJsonEditWidget / QgsSensorThingsSubsetEditor::QgsSensorThingsSubsetEditor / QgsLayoutHtmlWidget::QgsLayoutHtmlWidget)
- `src/ui/qgsattributeactionpropertiesdialogbase.ui:90-96,266-270` (mActionText)

## User impact
- Every expression-editing entry point in the vendored QGIS shell (data-defined overrides in labeling, layer properties expression insert, field calculator, select-by-expression) is a crash path in the shipped app.
- Processing vector-input options and the geometry-generator symbology workflow (plus DB import filter, attribute-form config expression, numeric-format expression widget) are crash paths in the app.
- One of the three core vector rendering modes is unusable; switching renderers in layer styling crashes the app.
- The whole property-assistant feature (non-linear data-defined size/rotation/transparency) is a crash path.
- Text annotation item creation crashes; processing model help editor (model designer, if reachable) same.
- Hard crash on multiple user-reachable UI paths in the shipped app (attribute table, processing dialogs). Same hazard class was acknowledged in-repo for the raster histogram widget but left unfixed for these widgets.
- Crash or corruption on feature forms with JSON fields; SensorThings/layout-HTML paths are lower-reachability but same mechanism.
- Whole Actions feature degraded to data loss: existing actions destroyed on edit, new actions impossible.

## Reproduction
- **Trigger (UIF-1)**: Right-click a vector layer -> Properties (or Ctrl+I) -> Labels tab -> click any data-defined override button -> 'Edit Expression...' (also: Display tab 'Insert Expression' button, attribute table field calculator icon, select-by-expression).
- **Trigger (UIF-2)**: In any Processing algorithm dialog with a vector input, click the input's options (...) button -> '<param> Options' panel opens; or in layer styling add a Geometry Generator symbol layer.
- **Trigger (UIF-3)**: Open vector layer properties, Symbology, choose Graduated renderer.
- **Trigger (UIF-4)**: Open any data-defined property assistant (layer styling/labeling -> override button -> Assistant...).
- **Trigger (UIF-5)**: Create any text annotation item in the annotation layer workflow.
- **Trigger (VPATCH-1)**: Open attribute table on a vector layer, open the sort dialog (or edit a stored filter expression); or open the source options panel of any vector parameter in an algorithm dialog.
- **Trigger (VPATCH-2)**: Open a feature form for a layer containing a JSON-type attribute.
- **Trigger (UIF-8)**: Edit an existing layer action and press OK; or try to create a new action.

## Expected behavior
- **Expected (UIF-1)**: The Expression Builder dialog opens with a functional expression tree + editor.
- **Expected (UIF-2)**: Options panel / geometry-generator symbol layer widget opens with an expression line edit.
- **Expected (UIF-3)**: Graduated renderer page with histogram view.
- **Expected (UIF-4)**: Assistant dialog with an interactive curve editor.
- **Expected (UIF-5)**: Item properties widget with rich-text editor.
- **Expected (VPATCH-1)**: Either the implementations are compiled, or every construction site is guarded/removed as was done for QgsRasterHistogramWidget (qgsrasterlayerproperties.cpp:421-423) and QgsHistoryProviderRegistry defaults (qgsgui.cpp:355-356).
- **Expected (VPATCH-2)**: Widget trimmed from the build should not be registered/constructible from compiled code.
- **Expected (UIF-8)**: Dialog shows the current action command; edits are saved.

## Actual behavior
- **Actual (UIF-1)**: uic setupUi allocates QgsExpressionBuilderWidget via operator new and 'constructs' it with the empty stub: QObject/QWidget base constructors never run, vptr and d_ptr are uninitialized garbage; the very next member call (setObjectName in setupUi, then the dialog's initGui access) dereferences garbage - deterministic UB, near-certain segfault.
- **Actual (UIF-2)**: QgsExpressionLineEdit instance is raw uninitialized memory (no QObject base constructed, no vtable); first signal connect or property access is UB - crash or garbage behavior.
- **Actual (UIF-3)**: mHistogramWidget is uninitialized memory; first use (setObjectName during setupUi or the widget's own ctor-time connect at qgsgraduatedsymbolrendererwidget.cpp) hits a garbage vptr - UB/crash.
- **Actual (UIF-4)**: mCurveEditor is an uninitialized QObject; the assistant's ctor-time property access on it is UB - crash.
- **Actual (UIF-5)**: mTextEdit is uninitialized memory; widget setup dereferences a garbage vptr/d_ptr - UB/crash.
- **Actual (VPATCH-1)**: Construction runs a no-op constructor: QWidget/QObject bases are never initialized (d_ptr and vptr are garbage), then layout->addWidget()/virtual calls dereference uninitialized state — undefined behavior, in practice segfault or memory corruption.
- **Actual (VPATCH-2)**: Construction yields an uninitialized QWidget — UB/crash when the form adds or shows the widget (or silently broken JSON editing if it happens not to fault).
- **Actual (UIF-8)**: Command field always blank and untypable (inert widget); pressing OK stores actionText = "" - the action's command is silently wiped; 'Insert Field'/'Insert Expression' buttons are no-ops.

## Root cause
- **UIF-1**: CONFIRMED (P1; QgsExpressionBuilderWidget ctor shipped in libqgis_gui.so is a bare `ret` weak stub - objdump 18c6690; construction sites compiled+reachable: QgsDualView::modifySort qgsdualview.cpp:1152 via openAttributeTable (main_window_menus.cpp:203), QgsVectorLayerProperties::insertOrEditExpression (qgsvectorlayerproperties.cpp:553), QgsPropertyOverrideButton::showExpressionDialog (qgspropertyoverridebutton.cpp:677), qgsfeatureselectiondlg.cpp)
  - *Callchain*: `src/app/active_view_host.cpp:419 QgsVectorLayerProperties dialog -> Labels tab (QgsLabelingWidget->QgsLabelingGui->QgsTextFormatWidget: 111 QgsPropertyOverrideButton instances in src/ui/qgstextformatwidgetbase.ui) -> qgspropertyoverridebutton.cpp:677 'QgsExpressionBuilderDialog d(...)' -> setupUi -> new QgsExpressionBuilderWidget -> empty stub ctor. Same dialog also constructed at src/gui/vector/qgsvectorlayerproperties.cpp:552 (insertOrEditExpression), src/gui/raster/qgsrasterlayerproperties.cpp:281, src/gui/qgsfeatureselectiondlg.cpp (expression selection), src/app/qgsattributetabledialog.cpp (field calculator -> qgsfieldcalculatorbase.ui:188 builder).`
  - *Code context*: `Form: <widget class="QgsExpressionBuilderWidget" name="builder" native="true"> with customwidget header qgsexpressionbuilderwidget.h. Build: src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1924-1938 does list(REMOVE_ITEM QGIS_GUI_SRCS codeeditors/... ) and 1918-1923 removes qgsexpressionbuilderwidget.cpp, so the only constructor is the weak void stub at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:343-345 (_ZN26QgsExpressionBuilderWidgetC1EP7QWidget). Binary proof: objdump of build/src/gui/libqgis_gui.so shows the shipped ctor is 5 instructions (push rbp; mov rsp,rbp; nop; pop rbp; ret) - no base-class construction, no vtable assignment.`
- **UIF-2**: CONFIRMED (P1; QgsExpressionLineEdit ctor bare `ret` 18c6970 + ~6 call sites; QgsProcessingFeatureSourceOptionsWidget via QgsProcessingMapLayerComboBox::showSourceOptions qgsprocessingmaplayercombobox.cpp:711 reachable from SicnuAlgorithmDialog; geometry-generator/DB-import/attribute-form/numeric-format sites also compiled)
  - *Callchain*: `Processing path: SicnuAlgorithmDialog/toolbox algorithm dialog (qgsprocessingalgorithmdialogbase.ui) -> QgsProcessingMapLayerComboBox::showSourceOptions (src/gui/processing/qgsprocessingmaplayercombobox.cpp:711) 'new QgsProcessingFeatureSourceOptionsWidget()' -> setupUi creates mFilterExpressionWidget -> empty stub ctor. Geometry-generator path: symbology -> add Geometry Generator symbol layer -> QgsGeometryGeneratorSymbolLayerWidget ctor (src/gui/symbology/qgssymbollayerwidget.cpp:5030 setupUi, :5045 connect(modificationExpressionSelector, &QgsExpressionLineEdit::expressionChanged, ...) immediately dispatches on the uninitialized object).`
  - *Code context*: `Each form embeds <widget class="QgsExpressionLineEdit" ... native="true">. src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1918-1923 removes qgsexpressionlineedit.cpp from QGIS_GUI_SRCS; the only ctor left is the weak void stub src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:528-529 (_ZN21QgsExpressionLineEditC1EP7QWidget). nm -D build/src/gui/libqgis_gui.so confirms the symbol resolves to the weak stub in the shipped library.`
- **UIF-3**: CONFIRMED (P1; QgsGraduatedHistogramWidget ctor bare `ret` 18c6bf0; constructed by QgsGraduatedSymbolRendererWidget::create registered in qgsrendererpropertiesdialog.cpp:78, created when user picks Graduated renderer in Symbology tab of QgsVectorLayerProperties - reachable via active_view_host.cpp:419)
  - *Callchain*: `Vector Layer Properties (src/app/active_view_host.cpp:419) -> Symbology tab -> renderer dropdown 'Graduated' -> QgsRendererPropertiesDialog creates QgsGraduatedSymbolRendererWidget (compiled, CMakeLists entry present) -> setupUi instantiates mHistogramWidget via the empty stub.`
  - *Code context*: `<widget class="QgsGraduatedHistogramWidget" name="mHistogramWidget" native="true">; src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1909-1915 removes symbology/qgsgraduatedhistogramwidget.cpp (QWT-dependent); weak void ctor at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:688-689; nm -D build/src/gui/libqgis_gui.so shows the weak stub is the linked definition.`
- **UIF-4**: CONFIRMED (corrected P2; QgsCurveEditorWidget ctor bare `ret` 18c6590; mCurveEditor from qgspropertyassistantwidgetbase.ui:197 used by QgsPropertyAssistantWidget (compiled qgspropertyassistantwidget.cpp:137-146 connects on uninitialized object); reachable via data-defined override Assistant menu)
  - *Callchain*: `Data-defined override button (e.g. in labeling/qgstextformatwidgetbase.ui) -> menu 'Assistant...' -> QgsPropertyAssistantWidget (src/gui/qgspropertyassistantwidget.cpp) -> setupUi creates mCurveEditor via empty stub.`
  - *Code context*: `<widget class="QgsCurveEditorWidget" name="mCurveEditor" native="true">; src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1910 removes qgscurveeditorwidget.cpp (QWT-dependent); weak void ctor at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:280-281 (_ZN20QgsCurveEditorWidgetC1EP7QWidgetRK17QgsCurveTransform); consumer qgspropertyassistantwidget.cpp compiled and live.`
- **UIF-5**: CONFIRMED at lowered reachability (corrected P3; QgsRichTextEditor ctor bare `ret` 18c7230; consumers compiled (qgsannotationitemwidget_impl) but NO annotation-item or model-designer UI entry exists in this app (grep of main_window*/shell/panels: zero refs) - mechanical UB certain, user reachability doubtful)
  - *Callchain*: `Layer -> Annotations -> add Line/Point/Rectangle text item -> QgsAnnotationTextItem widget (qgsannotationitemwidget_impl) -> setupUi creates mTextEdit via empty stub.`
  - *Code context*: `Forms embed <widget class="QgsRichTextEditor" ... native="true">; src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1942-1953 removes qgsrichtexteditor.cpp; weak void ctor at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:1088-1089 (_ZN17QgsRichTextEditorC1EP7QWidget); consumers in src/gui/annotations/qgsannotationitemwidget_impl.h are compiled.`
- **VPATCH-1**: CONFIRMED (P1; same class as UIF-1/UIF-2, additional sites qgsfeaturefilterwidget.cpp:378 editStoredFilterExpression + qgsprocessingwidgetwrapperimpl.cpp/qgsprocessingconfigurationwidgets.cpp; suggest MERGE into UIF-1/UIF-2 members - it is the same hazard, not a distinct defect)
  - *Callchain*: `App: QgisDesktopWindow::openAttributeTable (src/app/main_window_vector.cpp:363) -> QgsAttributeTableDialog (src/app/qgsattributetabledialog.cpp) -> QgsDualView::modifySort -> new QgsExpressionBuilderWidget -> no-op ctor -> sortingGroupBox->layout()->addWidget(uninitialized QWidget). Processing: SicnuAlgorithmDialog -> QgsProcessingMapLayerComboBox::showSourceOptions (qgsprocessingmaplayercombobox.cpp:711) -> QgsProcessingFeatureSourceOptionsWidget ctor setupUi -> new QgsExpressionLineEdit. Attribute table filter menu -> QgsFeatureFilterWidget::editStoredFilterExpression -> new QgsExpressionLineEdit.`
  - *Code context*: `CMake removes qgsexpressionlineedit.cpp and qgsexpressionbuilderwidget.cpp from QGIS_GUI_SRCS; the only remaining definitions are weak C no-ops: 'void _ZN21QgsExpressionLineEditC1EP7QWidget(void) __attribute__((weak...)); void ...(void) {}'. Compiled upstream-pristine call sites still construct them: src/gui/attributetable/qgsdualview.cpp:1152 'new QgsExpressionBuilderWidget()' inside QgsDualView::modifySort(); src/gui/attributetable/qgsfeaturefilterwidget.cpp:378 'new QgsExpressionLineEdit( dlg )' in editStoredFilterExpression(); src/ui/processing/qgsprocessingfeaturesourceoptionsbase.ui:95 promotes QgsExpressionLineEdit (setupUi -> new); also qgsprocessingwidgetwrapperimpl.cpp:2583,2744,2776; qgsprocessingconfigurationwidgets.cpp:107,151,240,280; qgsprocessingmodelerparameterwidget.cpp:105.`
- **VPATCH-2**: CONFIRMED (corrected P2; QgsJsonEditWidget ctor bare `ret` 18c6cd0 - reachable via QgsJsonEditWrapper::createWidget (qgsjsoneditwrapper.cpp:40, registered editor type) when a feature form opens on a JSON-typed field; QgsLayoutHtmlWidget (18c6d90) reachable via layout designer (QgsLayoutDesignerDialog created in app, main_window_project.cpp:67 -> add HTML item via qgslayoutguiutils.cpp:534); QgsSensorThingsSubsetEditor (18c7510) NOT reachable from this app (no SensorThings UI) )
  - *Callchain*: `Feature form (attribute table form view / identify feature form) on a vector layer with a JSON-typed field (e.g. GeoPackage JSON column) -> QgsEditorWidgetRegistry creates QgsJsonEditWrapper -> createWidget -> new QgsJsonEditWidget -> no-op weak ctor -> uninitialized QWidget handed to the form layout.`
  - *Code context*: `qgsjsoneditwidget.cpp, qgssensorthingssubseteditor.cpp, qgslayouthtmlwidget.cpp removed from QGIS_GUI_SRCS (src/gui/CMakeLists.txt trim lists) but compiled code still constructs them: src/gui/editorwidgets/qgsjsoneditwrapper.cpp:40 'new QgsJsonEditWidget( parent )' and :51; src/gui/providers/sensorthings/qgssensorthingsguiprovider.cpp:138 'return new QgsSensorThingsSubsetEditor(...)'; src/gui/layout/qgslayoutguiutils.cpp:534 'return new QgsLayoutHtmlWidget(...)'. The Json editor widget stays registered in QgsEditorWidgetRegistry via qgsjsoneditwrapper (registered for JSON-typed fields).`
- **UIF-8**: Layer Actions dialog's command editor is a stubbed QgsCodeEditorPython - existing action commands are wiped on save and cannot be edited or created
  - *Callchain*: `Vector Layer Properties -> Actions tab (mOptsPage_Actions at qgsvectorlayerpropertiesbase.ui:1317) -> QgsAttributeActionDialog (constructed qgsvectorlayerproperties.cpp:225) -> Add/Edit action -> QgsAttributeActionPropertiesDialog.`
  - *Code context*: `<widget class="QgsCodeEditorPython" name="mActionText" native="true">; stubbed codeeditor family: setText no-op, text() returns {}, insertText no-op (antigravity_codeeditor_stubs.cpp; src/stubs/Qsci/qsciscintilla.h:75-76). Consumer src/gui/vector/qgsattributeactionpropertiesdialog.cpp (compiled): :64 'mActionText->setText(actionText)' (edit dialog opens blank), :108 'return mActionText->text();' (always saves ""), :165/:176 'mActionText->insertText(...)' (insert-field buttons do nothing).`

## Evidence
- **Skeptic verification**: Tried: (a) does a strong definition override the weak stub? nm -D on build src/gui/libqgis_gui.so shows only W (weak) defs; disassembly of the shipped ctor is `ret` + nops (no base init, no vptr write, not even push/pop); objdump shows dozens of `call <X ctor>@plt` from compiled consumers (QgsDualView, uic setupUi, QgsExpressionBuilderDialog, QgsProcessing*). (b) are real .cpp compiled elsewhere? all REMOVE_ITEM'd from QGIS_GUI_SRCS (src/gui/CMakeLists.txt 1908-1963), no other target compiles them. (c) is setupUi executable? yes - uic calls setObjectName() immediately on the garbage object -> d_ptr deref -> UB/crash. (d) reachability: layer properties (active_view_host.cpp:419; triggered from app menus main_window_layers.cpp:251/297, layer_tree_menu.cpp:78, main_window_connections.cpp:420), attribute table (main_window_menus.cpp:203->openAttributeTable), processing options - all first-party compiled paths confirmed. Could not refute; P1 holds for UIF-1/2/3/VPATCH-1 (user-visible crash), lower for the rest.
- **Review note**: No line drift (CMakeLists trim block 1908-1963; stubs at antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:280-281/344-345/528-529/688-689/744-745/792-793/1088-1089/1272-1273). Severity corrections: UIF-4 & VPATCH-2 downgraded to P2, UIF-5 to P3 (low app reachability). Structural note: members UIF-1..5/VPATCH-1/2 are one homogeneous machine-level class (weak-stub ctor of a REMOVE_ITEM'd widget still constructible from compiled callers); VPATCH-1 duplicates UIF-1/UIF-2 sites and should be merged into them rather than kept separate.
- **Finding UIF-1**: `Form: <widget class="QgsExpressionBuilderWidget" name="builder" native="true"> with customwidget header qgsexpressionbuilderwidget.h. Build: src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1924-1938 does list(REMOVE_ITEM QGIS_GUI_SRCS codeeditors/... ) and 1918-1923 removes qgsexpressionbuilderwidget.cpp, so the only constructor is the weak void stub at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:343-345 (_ZN26QgsExpressionBuilderWidgetC1EP7QWidget). Binary proof: objdump of build/src/gui/libqgis_gui.so shows the shipped ctor is 5 instructions (push rbp; mov rsp,rbp; nop; pop rbp; ret) - no base-class construction, no vtable assignment.`
- **Finding UIF-2**: `Each form embeds <widget class="QgsExpressionLineEdit" ... native="true">. src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1918-1923 removes qgsexpressionlineedit.cpp from QGIS_GUI_SRCS; the only ctor left is the weak void stub src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:528-529 (_ZN21QgsExpressionLineEditC1EP7QWidget). nm -D build/src/gui/libqgis_gui.so confirms the symbol resolves to the weak stub in the shipped library.`
- **Finding UIF-3**: `<widget class="QgsGraduatedHistogramWidget" name="mHistogramWidget" native="true">; src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1909-1915 removes symbology/qgsgraduatedhistogramwidget.cpp (QWT-dependent); weak void ctor at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:688-689; nm -D build/src/gui/libqgis_gui.so shows the weak stub is the linked definition.`
- **Finding UIF-4**: `<widget class="QgsCurveEditorWidget" name="mCurveEditor" native="true">; src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1910 removes qgscurveeditorwidget.cpp (QWT-dependent); weak void ctor at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:280-281 (_ZN20QgsCurveEditorWidgetC1EP7QWidgetRK17QgsCurveTransform); consumer qgspropertyassistantwidget.cpp compiled and live.`
- **Finding UIF-5**: `Forms embed <widget class="QgsRichTextEditor" ... native="true">; src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:1942-1953 removes qgsrichtexteditor.cpp; weak void ctor at src/gui/antigravity_qgsgui_stubs.c:1088-1089 (_ZN17QgsRichTextEditorC1EP7QWidget); consumers in src/gui/annotations/qgsannotationitemwidget_impl.h are compiled.`
- **Finding VPATCH-1**: `CMake removes qgsexpressionlineedit.cpp and qgsexpressionbuilderwidget.cpp from QGIS_GUI_SRCS; the only remaining definitions are weak C no-ops: 'void _ZN21QgsExpressionLineEditC1EP7QWidget(void) __attribute__((weak...)); void ...(void) {}'. Compiled upstream-pristine call sites still construct them: src/gui/attributetable/qgsdualview.cpp:1152 'new QgsExpressionBuilderWidget()' inside QgsDualView::modifySort(); src/gui/attributetable/qgsfeaturefilterwidget.cpp:378 'new QgsExpressionLineEdit( dlg )' in editStoredFilterExpression(); src/ui/processing/qgsprocessingfeaturesourceoptionsbase.ui:95 promotes QgsExpressionLineEdit (setupUi -> new); also qgsprocessingwidgetwrapperimpl.cpp:2583,2744,2776; qgsprocessingconfigurationwidgets.cpp:107,151,240,280; qgsprocessingmodelerparameterwidget.cpp:105.`
- **Finding VPATCH-2**: `qgsjsoneditwidget.cpp, qgssensorthingssubseteditor.cpp, qgslayouthtmlwidget.cpp removed from QGIS_GUI_SRCS (src/gui/CMakeLists.txt trim lists) but compiled code still constructs them: src/gui/editorwidgets/qgsjsoneditwrapper.cpp:40 'new QgsJsonEditWidget( parent )' and :51; src/gui/providers/sensorthings/qgssensorthingsguiprovider.cpp:138 'return new QgsSensorThingsSubsetEditor(...)'; src/gui/layout/qgslayoutguiutils.cpp:534 'return new QgsLayoutHtmlWidget(...)'. The Json editor widget stays registered in QgsEditorWidgetRegistry via qgsjsoneditwrapper (registered for JSON-typed fields).`
- **Finding UIF-8**: `<widget class="QgsCodeEditorPython" name="mActionText" native="true">; stubbed codeeditor family: setText no-op, text() returns {}, insertText no-op (antigravity_codeeditor_stubs.cpp; src/stubs/Qsci/qsciscintilla.h:75-76). Consumer src/gui/vector/qgsattributeactionpropertiesdialog.cpp (compiled): :64 'mActionText->setText(actionText)' (edit dialog opens blank), :108 'return mActionText->text();' (always saves ""), :165/:176 'mActionText->insertText(...)' (insert-field buttons do nothing).`

## Suggested fix
- Ensure widgets are fully initialized or stubbed safely, signals/slots are correctly connected to backend results, and UI elements do not block the main event loop.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defect resolved for all members (UIF-1, UIF-2, UIF-3, UIF-4, UIF-5, VPATCH-1, VPATCH-2, UIF-8).
- CMake build and Catch2 unit test suite pass with 100% success.
- No regression in existing functionality or contracts.

## Regression tests
- Add targeted unit/integration tests covering the affected code path(s).

## Risk / compatibility
- Low risk when applying surgical, isolated fixes matching existing conventions.

## References / Dedupe
- issues-closed.txt scanned: #212 shortcut conflict, #235 qwt_plot_renderer stub, #236 GUI-minors batch, #238 widget minors - none cover codeeditor/expression-builder weak-stub ctor crashes or the trimmed-widget hazard. No overlap.
- Finding UIF-1: No prior coverage: issues-closed.txt has no codeeditor/stub item (#212 is a different shortcut conflict; #238 is QSS/dark-theme; #235 is qwt stub renderer only). grep of findings-*.jsonl for CodeEditor/ExpressionBuilder/stub: no matches.
- Finding UIF-2: No prior coverage in issues-closed.txt (grep codeeditor/expression/stub: none) nor in existing findings-*.jsonl (SHELLB-10 covers first-party SchemaFormBuilder combo defaults - unrelated).
- Finding UIF-3: No prior coverage (issues-closed grep histogram: only #238 JM-matrix and raster histogram widget skip which is a different file and intentional).
- Finding UIF-4: None in issues-closed.txt or findings-*.jsonl (grep curve/assistant/stub: no matches).
- Finding UIF-5: None (grep rich/annotation/stub in issues-closed.txt and findings-*.jsonl: no matches).
- Finding VPATCH-1: Not covered by closed issues: #234 is ODR/build minors, #235 is qwt_plot_renderer stub, #236 GUI-minors batch lists different defects, #224 uncompiled tests. No prior issue mentions expression-widget stub crashes.
